quote: they were transported to the Research Center for temporary breeding for 2 weeks, continuously inflated, and fed with commercial compound feed once in the morning and once in the evening every day, and treated with sewage and water exchange.
statement: During two weeks of temporary breeding, fish were continuously aerated, fed twice daily with commercial compound feed, and subjected to waste removal and water exchange.
text_en: During two weeks of temporary breeding, fish were continuously aerated, fed twice daily with commercial compound feed, and subjected to waste removal and water exchange.
intervention: Continuous aeration, feeding and water change
intervention_record: 连续充气、投喂、排污换水

quote: During this period, fish that died or survived in poor condition were removed.
statement: Dead fish or those surviving in poor condition were removed during the temporary culture period.
text_en: Dead fish or those surviving in poor condition were removed during the temporary culture period.

quote: Feeding was prohibited 2 days before the start of the experiment.
statement: Feeding was stopped two days prior to the commencement of the experiment.
text_en: Feeding was stopped two days prior to the commencement of the experiment.

quote: Dissolved oxygen ≥ 7 mg/L, pH 7–8, and water temperature 16.30 ± 2.44 °C.
statement: Water quality parameters were maintained with dissolved oxygen at least 7 mg/L, pH between 7 and 8, and water temperature around 16.30 ± 2.44 °C.
text_en: Water quality parameters were maintained with dissolved oxygen at least 7 mg/L, pH between 7 and 8, and water temperature around 16.30 ± 2.44 °C.

quote: LDA distinguished each crucian carp muscle test group exposed to different concentrations of eugenol and the control group, and showed no overlapping area.
statement: 线性判别分析（LDA）能够区分暴露于不同浓度丁香酚的鲫鱼肌肉测试组与对照组，且无重叠区域。
text_zh: 线性判别分析（LDA）能够区分暴露于不同浓度丁香酚的鲫鱼肌肉测试组与对照组，且无重叠区域。
text_en: Linear discriminant analysis (LDA) can distinguish between crucian carp muscle test groups exposed to different concentrations of eugenol and the control group, with no overlapping regions.

quote: In our study, the content of RBC, WBC, PLT, and HGB in crucian carp after anesthesia with different concentrations of eugenol was lower than that in the control group.
statement: 在本研究中，经不同浓度丁香酚麻醉后，鲫鱼血液中的红细胞、白细胞、血小板和血红蛋白含量低于对照组。
text_zh: 在本研究中，经不同浓度丁香酚麻醉后，鲫鱼血液中的红细胞、白细胞、血小板和血红蛋白含量低于对照组。
text_en: In this study, after anesthesia with different concentrations of eugenol, the contents of red blood cells, white blood cells, platelets, and hemoglobin in the blood of crucian carp were lower than those in the control group.
counterevidence: 与Liang等人关于罗非鱼丁香油麻醉的研究结果相反，后者发现麻醉后血液指标升高。

quote: The muscle fiber sizes among the concentration groups differed, the muscle fiber arrangement was disordered, and the muscle fiber diameter was significantly smaller than that in the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，不同浓度丁香酚麻醉组的肌纤维尺寸存在差异，排列紊乱，且肌纤维直径显著减小。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，不同浓度丁香酚麻醉组的肌纤维尺寸存在差异，排列紊乱，且肌纤维直径显著减小。
text_en: Compared with the control group, there were differences in muscle fiber size in the eugenol anesthesia groups at different concentrations; the arrangement was disordered, and the muscle fiber diameter decreased significantly.

quote: In the 20–80 mg/L concentration group, the muscle fiber gap was further widened, the muscle fiber was disordered, and a clear fracture phenomenon occurred.
statement: 在20–80 mg/L浓度组中，肌纤维间隙进一步加宽，肌纤维排列紊乱，并出现明显的断裂现象。
text_zh: 在20–80 mg/L浓度组中，肌纤维间隙进一步加宽，肌纤维排列紊乱，并出现明显的断裂现象。
text_en: In the 20–80 mg/L concentration groups, the inter-fiber spaces were further widened, muscle fiber arrangement was disordered, and obvious breakage occurred.

quote: The concentration of eugenol in the control group was higher than that in all experimental groups except the 80 mg/L group.
statement: 对照组中丁香酚的浓度高于除80 mg/L组以外的所有实验组。
text_zh: 对照组中丁香酚的浓度高于除80 mg/L组以外的所有实验组。
text_en: The concentration of eugenol in the control group was higher than that in all experimental groups except the 80 mg/L group.
outcome: 肌肉挥发性风味物质组成

quote: The effects of eugenol on the muscle in crucian carp in the other experimental groups were unclear, and the difference in the response signal intensity was small.
statement: 其他实验组中丁香酚对鲫鱼肌肉的影响尚不清楚，且响应信号强度的差异较小。
text_zh: 其他实验组中丁香酚对鲫鱼肌肉的影响尚不清楚，且响应信号强度的差异较小。
text_en: The effects of eugenol on the muscle of crucian carp in other experimental groups remain unclear, and the differences in response signal intensity are small.

quote: In contrast with the control group, the 20, 60, 70, and 80 mg/L eugenol-treated groups showed edema and elevation of the gill lamellae, which were not neatly arranged (neither perpendicular to the gill filaments nor parallel to one another), and the bases of the gill lamellae were elevated and not smooth.
statement: 与对照组相比，20、60、70和80 mg/L丁香酚处理组的鳃小片出现水肿和隆起，排列不整齐，且鳃小片基部隆起不平滑。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，20、60、70和80 mg/L丁香酚处理组的鳃小片出现水肿和隆起，排列不整齐，且鳃小片基部隆起不平滑。
text_en: Compared with the control group, edema and bulging of the secondary lamellae, irregular arrangement, and uneven bulging at the base of the secondary lamellae were observed in the groups treated with eugenol at 20, 60, 70, and 80 mg/L.

quote: The liver samples of all anesthetized groups were compared with those in the control group, and no significant changes in normal liver histology were observed.
statement: 所有麻醉组的肝脏样本与对照组相比，未观察到正常肝脏组织学的显著变化。
text_zh: 所有麻醉组的肝脏样本与对照组相比，未观察到正常肝脏组织学的显著变化。
text_en: No significant changes in normal liver histology were observed in the liver samples of all anesthesia groups compared to the control group.

quote: Pharmacodynamic studies have indicated that eugenol has sterilization, antioxidative, anesthetic, and analgesic effects
statement: 药效学研究表明丁香酚具有杀菌、抗氧化、麻醉和镇痛作用。
text_zh: 药效学研究表明丁香酚具有杀菌、抗氧化、麻醉和镇痛作用。
text_en: Pharmacodynamic studies show that eugenol has bactericidal, antioxidant, anesthetic and analgesic effects.

quote: Eugenol, as an anesthetic, inhibits the sensory center of the fish brain and elicits decreases in, or even a loss of, reflexes.
statement: 作为麻醉剂，丁香酚抑制鱼类大脑的感觉中枢，导致反射减少甚至消失。
text_zh: 作为麻醉剂，丁香酚抑制鱼类大脑的感觉中枢，导致反射减少甚至消失。
text_en: As an anesthetic, eugenol inhibits the sensory centers of the fish brain, leading to reduced or even absent reflexes.

quote: Its mechanism of action is divided primarily into three stages: the tactile loss period, the excitation period, and the anesthesia period.
statement: 其作用机制主要分为三个阶段：触觉丧失期、兴奋期和麻醉期。
text_zh: 其作用机制主要分为三个阶段：触觉丧失期、兴奋期和麻醉期。
text_en: Its mechanism of action is mainly divided into three stages: the tactile loss stage, the excitement stage, and the anesthesia stage.

quote: Eugenol has attracted attention in recent years because of its low cost, high efficiency, safety in live fish transportation, and good solubility in freshwater and seawater.
statement: 近年来丁香酚因其成本低、效率高、在活鱼运输中的安全性以及在淡水和海水中的良好溶解性而受到关注。
text_zh: 近年来丁香酚因其成本低、效率高、在活鱼运输中的安全性以及在淡水和海水中的良好溶解性而受到关注。
text_en: In recent years, eugenol has attracted attention due to its low cost, high efficiency, safety in live fish transport, and good solubility in both freshwater and seawater.

quote: It is widely used in fish production and in scientific experiments, such as broodstock egg collection, live fish transportation, and in vivo surgery
statement: 它广泛用于鱼类生产和科学实验，如亲本采卵、活鱼运输和体内手术。
text_zh: 它广泛用于鱼类生产和科学实验，如亲本采卵、活鱼运输和体内手术。
text_en: It is widely used in fish production and scientific experiments, such as parent spawning, live fish transport, and in vivo surgery.

quote: During transportation, crucian carp show an intense stress response.
statement: 鲫鱼在运输过程中表现出强烈的应激反应。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在运输过程中表现出强烈的应激反应。
text_en: Crucian carp exhibit a strong stress response during transportation.

quote: Improper operations can easily cause quality deterioration and death, thus substantially affecting breeding production and transportation.
statement: 不当操作容易导致品质恶化和死亡，从而严重影响养殖生产和运输。
text_zh: 不当操作容易导致品质恶化和死亡，从而严重影响养殖生产和运输。
text_en: Improper handling easily leads to quality deterioration and death, thereby seriously affecting aquaculture production and transportation.

quote: The rational use of fish anesthetics can place fish in a state of anesthesia and sedation, thereby decreasing their consumption of oxygen and energy, and metabolic rate; alleviating their stress response; and facilitating operations and transportation [ 2 ].
statement: 合理使用鱼类麻醉剂可使鱼处于麻醉和镇静状态，从而降低其氧气和能量消耗及代谢率；缓解应激反应；并便于操作和运输。
text_zh: 合理使用鱼类麻醉剂可使鱼处于麻醉和镇静状态，从而降低其氧气和能量消耗及代谢率；缓解应激反应；并便于操作和运输。
text_en: The reasonable use of fish anesthetics can put fish into an anesthetized and sedated state, thereby reducing their oxygen and energy consumption and metabolic rate; alleviating stress responses; and facilitating handling and transport.
outcome: 应激反应、代谢率、氧气消耗

quote: Simultaneously, the use of anesthetics can decrease activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary–adrenal axis [ 3 , 4 ], diminish the pressure and physical damage caused by operations, and help improve fish welfare.
statement: 同时，使用麻醉剂可降低下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴的激活，减少操作引起的压力和物理损伤，有助于改善鱼类福利。
text_zh: 同时，使用麻醉剂可降低下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺轴的激活，减少操作引起的压力和物理损伤，有助于改善鱼类福利。
text_en: At the same time, using anesthetics can reduce the activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, decrease stress and physical damage caused by handling, and help improve fish welfare.

quote: MS-222 is the only anesthetic approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), but its application is not safe, owing to a decrease in pH value and the formation of methanesulfonic acid [ 6 ].
statement: MS-222是唯一获美国食品药品监督管理局批准的麻醉剂，但由于pH值下降和甲磺酸的形成，其应用并不安全。
text_zh: MS-222是唯一获美国食品药品监督管理局批准的麻醉剂，但由于pH值下降和甲磺酸的形成，其应用并不安全。
text_en: MS-222 is the only anesthetic approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration, but its application is not safe due to a decrease in pH and the formation of methanesulfonic acid.

quote: The advantage of carbon dioxide over other anesthetics is that it does not require a period of withdrawal, but its anesthetic dose is difficult to control [ 7 ].
statement: 二氧化碳相对于其他麻醉剂的优势在于不需要停药期，但其麻醉剂量难以控制。
text_zh: 二氧化碳相对于其他麻醉剂的优势在于不需要停药期，但其麻醉剂量难以控制。
text_en: The advantage of carbon dioxide over other anesthetics is that it does not require a withdrawal period, but its anesthetic dose is difficult to control.

quote: Eugenol at 40–80 mg/L has anesthetic effects on Trachidermus fasciatus
statement: 浓度为40–80 mg/L的丁香酚对虎头鱼具有麻醉效果。
text_zh: 浓度为40–80 mg/L的丁香酚对虎头鱼具有麻醉效果。
text_en: Eugenol at a concentration of 40–80 mg/L has an anesthetic effect on tigerhead fish.

quote: and eugenol at 20–70 mg/L has anesthetic effects on Trachinotus ovatus
statement: 浓度为20–70 mg/L的丁香酚对卵形鲳鲹具有麻醉效果。
text_zh: 浓度为20–70 mg/L的丁香酚对卵形鲳鲹具有麻醉效果。
text_en: Eugenol at a concentration of 20–70 mg/L has an anesthetic effect on Trachinotus ovatus.

quote: Eugenol effectively decreases stress effects in fish, and increases the transportation density and survival rate; consequently, it is frequently used in the transportation of live fish.
statement: 丁香酚能有效降低鱼类的应激反应，提高运输密度和存活率，因此常用于活鱼运输。
text_zh: 丁香酚能有效降低鱼类的应激反应，提高运输密度和存活率，因此常用于活鱼运输。
text_en: Eugenol can effectively reduce the stress response of fish, improve transport density and survival rate, and is therefore commonly used in live fish transport.

quote: Studies have observed substantial differences in the appropriate anesthetic concentrations of eugenol for different fish species.
statement: 研究观察到不同鱼类物种所需的丁香酚适宜麻醉浓度存在显著差异。
text_zh: 研究观察到不同鱼类物种所需的丁香酚适宜麻醉浓度存在显著差异。
text_en: The study observed significant differences in the appropriate eugenol anaesthetic concentrations required for different fish species.
limitations: 不同物种间存在显著差异

quote: The increase in muscle glycogen and liver glycogen concentration in the anesthesia group was much higher than that in the control group, possibly because of the decrease in metabolic rate and the accumulation of muscle and liver glycogen after anesthesia.
statement: 麻醉组肌肉和肝脏糖原浓度显著高于对照组，可能是因为麻醉后代谢率降低导致糖原积累。
text_zh: 麻醉组肌肉和肝脏糖原浓度显著高于对照组，可能是因为麻醉后代谢率降低导致糖原积累。
text_en: Muscle and liver glycogen concentrations in the anesthesia group were significantly higher than those in the control group, possibly due to reduced metabolic rate after anesthesia leading to glycogen accumulation.

quote: In the future development of fishery anesthetics, more products with less influence on flavor should be considered.
statement: 在未来渔业麻醉剂的开发中，应考虑更多对风味影响较小的产品。
text_zh: 在未来渔业麻醉剂的开发中，应考虑更多对风味影响较小的产品。
text_en: In the future development of fishery anesthetics, more products with less impact on flavor should be considered.

quote: We speculated that eugenol anesthesia might have influenced blood function in fish, in contrast to the results in tilapia research.
statement: 作者推测丁香酚麻醉可能影响了鱼类的血液功能，这与罗非鱼的研究结果形成对比。
text_zh: 作者推测丁香酚麻醉可能影响了鱼类的血液功能，这与罗非鱼的研究结果形成对比。
text_en: The authors speculated that eugenol anesthesia may have affected the blood function of fish, which contrasts with the results from tilapia studies.

quote: An increase in LDH activity reflects the degree of damage to the kidney of the myocardial cell nucleus [ 35 ].
statement: LDH活性的增加反映了心肌细胞核肾脏的损伤程度。
text_zh: LDH活性的增加反映了心肌细胞核肾脏的损伤程度。
text_en: The increase in LDH activity reflects the degree of damage to cardiomyocyte nuclei and kidneys.

quote: When the content of ALT and AST in the serum increases, hepatocytes are considered to be damaged, and ALT is an important indicator of liver damage.
statement: 当血清中ALT和AST含量增加时，认为肝细胞受损，且ALT是肝损伤的重要指标。
text_zh: 当血清中ALT和AST含量增加时，认为肝细胞受损，且ALT是肝损伤的重要指标。
text_en: When the levels of ALT and AST in serum increase, liver cell damage is considered to have occurred, and ALT is an important indicator of liver injury.

quote: In general, the concentrations of LDH, ALP, ALT, and AST in the serum of crucian carp increased after eugenol anesthesia, possibly because of the synthesis and release of enzymes in the body of crucian carp in response to the stress of eugenol anesthesia, thus increasing the activity of these enzymes.
statement: 丁香酚麻醉后，鲫鱼血清中LDH、ALP、ALT和AST浓度升高，这可能是由于鱼体对麻醉应激反应导致酶的合成和释放增加。
text_zh: 丁香酚麻醉后，鲫鱼血清中LDH、ALP、ALT和AST浓度升高，这可能是由于鱼体对麻醉应激反应导致酶的合成和释放增加。
text_en: After eugenol anesthesia, the concentrations of LDH, ALP, ALT and AST in the serum of crucian carp increased. This may be due to an increased synthesis and release of enzymes caused by the fish's stress response to anesthesia.
counterevidence: 酶浓度升高表明存在应激或组织损伤

quote: MS-222 has been shown to cause swelling of gill tissue [ 56 ], thereby hindering oxygen uptake by gill lamellae.
statement: MS-222 causes swelling of gill tissue, which hinders oxygen uptake by the gill lamellae.
text_en: MS-222 causes swelling of gill tissue, which hinders oxygen uptake by the gill lamellae.
outcome: 鳃组织肿胀与氧气摄取

quote: Oliveira et al. [ 57 ] have found that eugenol can cause mild lamellar epithelial hyperplasia in the gill tissue in freshwater fish.
statement: Eugenol can cause mild lamellar epithelial hyperplasia in the gill tissue of freshwater fish.
text_en: Eugenol can cause mild lamellar epithelial hyperplasia in the gill tissue of freshwater fish.

quote: Similar phenomena were also observed in this study.
statement: This study observed similar phenomena (mild lamellar epithelial hyperplasia) regarding eugenol effects on gill tissue.
text_en: This study observed similar phenomena (mild lamellar epithelial hyperplasia) regarding eugenol effects on gill tissue.

quote: In this study, the different eugenol anesthesia concentrations in crucian carp did not cause liver tissue damage, in agreement with findings by Velisek et al. [ 59 ], indicating that eugenol anesthesia in carp did not cause liver or kidney tissue damage.
statement: Different concentrations of eugenol anesthesia did not cause liver tissue damage in crucian carp, consistent with previous findings that it does not damage liver or kidney tissue in carp.
text_en: Different concentrations of eugenol anesthesia did not cause liver tissue damage in crucian carp, consistent with previous findings that it does not damage liver or kidney tissue in carp.

quote: A significant difference in serum Mg 2+ concentration was observed between the experimental group and the control group
statement: 麻醉后实验组血清Mg2+浓度与对照组相比存在显著差异。
text_zh: 麻醉后实验组血清Mg2+浓度与对照组相比存在显著差异。
text_en: After anesthesia, there was a significant difference in serum Mg2+ concentration between the experimental group and the control group.

quote: The serum Na + concentration in the control group was 82.77 ± 4.39 mmol/L, and was higher in each experimental group after anesthesia
statement: 麻醉后各实验组的血清Na+浓度高于对照组。
text_zh: 麻醉后各实验组的血清Na+浓度高于对照组。
text_en: After anesthesia, the serum Na+ concentrations in each experimental group were higher than those in the control group.

quote: A significant difference in serum Na + concentration was observed between the experimental group and the control group
statement: 麻醉后实验组血清Na+浓度与对照组相比存在显著差异。
text_zh: 麻醉后实验组血清Na+浓度与对照组相比存在显著差异。
text_en: After anesthesia, there was a significant difference in serum Na+ concentration between the experimental group and the control group.

quote: The concentration of ALB in the control group was 29.58 ± 3.25 g/L, whereas that in each experimental group was lower
statement: 各实验组的血清白蛋白（ALB）浓度低于对照组。
text_zh: 各实验组的血清白蛋白（ALB）浓度低于对照组。
text_en: The serum albumin (ALB) concentration in each experimental group was lower than that of the control group.

quote: A significant difference in ALB concentration was observed between the control group and each experimental group
statement: 对照组与各实验组之间的血清白蛋白（ALB）浓度存在显著差异。
text_zh: 对照组与各实验组之间的血清白蛋白（ALB）浓度存在显著差异。
text_en: There was a significant difference in serum albumin (ALB) concentration between the control group and each experimental group.

quote: The serum GLU concentration in crucian carp in the control group was 5.9 ± 0.11 mmol/L, and was higher in each experimental group
statement: 对照组鲫鱼的血清葡萄糖（GLU）浓度为5.9 ± 0.11 mmol/L，而各实验组该浓度更高。
text_zh: 对照组鲫鱼的血清葡萄糖（GLU）浓度为5.9 ± 0.11 mmol/L，而各实验组该浓度更高。
text_en: The serum glucose (GLU) concentration of crucian carp in the control group was 5.9 ± 0.11 mmol/L, while this concentration was higher in each experimental group.
outcome: 血液生化指标（葡萄糖/应激反应）

quote: The content of liver glycogen in each experimental group was higher than that in the control group
statement: 各实验组的肝糖原含量高于对照组。
text_zh: 各实验组的肝糖原含量高于对照组。
text_en: The liver glycogen content in each experimental group was higher than that in the control group.

quote: The muscle glycogen content of crucian carp in the control group was 3.12 ± 0.42 mg/g, which was similar to the change trend of liver glycogen.
statement: 对照组鲫鱼的肌肉糖原含量为3.12 ± 0.42 mg/g，其变化趋势与肝糖原相似。
text_zh: 对照组鲫鱼的肌肉糖原含量为3.12 ± 0.42 mg/g，其变化趋势与肝糖原相似。
text_en: The muscle glycogen content of crucian carp in the control group was 3.12 ± 0.42 mg/g, and its trend of change was similar to that of liver glycogen.
outcome: 能量代谢状态（肌肉糖原）

quote: A significant difference in muscle glycogen content was observed between the control group and each experimental group
statement: 对照组与各实验组之间的肌肉糖原含量存在显著差异。
text_zh: 对照组与各实验组之间的肌肉糖原含量存在显著差异。
text_en: There was a significant difference in muscle glycogen content between the control group and each experimental group.
outcome: 能量代谢状态（肌肉糖原）

quote: Anesthesia testing was performed according to the method of Favero et al. with appropriate modifications [ 24 ].
statement: 麻醉测试按照Favero等人的方法并进行了适当修改进行。
text_zh: 麻醉测试按照Favero等人的方法并进行了适当修改进行。
text_en: Anesthesia tests were performed according to the method of Favero et al. with appropriate modifications.

quote: The mass concentration gradient of eugenol was set to 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, and 80 mg/L, and a control without eugenol was additionally assessed.
statement: 丁香酚的质量浓度梯度设置为20、30、40、50、60、70和80 mg/L，并额外评估了不含丁香酚的对照组。
text_zh: 丁香酚的质量浓度梯度设置为20、30、40、50、60、70和80 mg/L，并额外评估了不含丁香酚的对照组。
text_en: The mass concentration gradient of eugenol was set at 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70 and 80 mg/L, and a control group without eugenol was additionally evaluated.

quote: Anesthesia was tested with a single-tailed experimental method; that is, each fish was used in only one experiment.
statement: 麻醉采用单尾实验法进行测试；即每条鱼仅用于一次实验。
text_zh: 麻醉采用单尾实验法进行测试；即每条鱼仅用于一次实验。
text_en: Anesthesia was tested using a single-tail experimental method; that is, each fish was used for only one experiment.

quote: In each experiment, when the fish entered the complete anesthesia period, the judgment standard of the complete anesthesia period was that the experimental fish lost the conditioned reflex ability to the external stimulation, the fish body tilted, did not struggle, the respiratory rate was decreased but regular, and the gill movement frequency was low.
statement: 在每次实验中，当鱼进入完全麻醉期时，完全麻醉期的判断标准是实验鱼失去对外部刺激的反射能力，鱼体倾斜，不挣扎，呼吸频率降低但规律，鳃运动频率低。
text_zh: 在每次实验中，当鱼进入完全麻醉期时，完全麻醉期的判断标准是实验鱼失去对外部刺激的反射能力，鱼体倾斜，不挣扎，呼吸频率降低但规律，鳃运动频率低。
text_en: In each experiment, when the fish entered the complete anesthesia stage, the criteria for determining the complete anesthesia stage were that the experimental fish lost reflex ability to external stimuli, the body tilted, did not struggle, respiration frequency decreased but remained regular, and gill movement frequency was low.

quote: Blood samples were collected after crucian carp were maintained under anesthesia for 10 min.
statement: 鲫鱼在麻醉状态下维持10分钟后采集血液样本。
text_zh: 鲫鱼在麻醉状态下维持10分钟后采集血液样本。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from crucian carp after maintaining anesthesia for 10 minutes.
outcome: 采样时机对生理指标的影响

quote: Using a 5 mL disposable sterile syringe to draw blood from the tail vein of crucian carp, the blood volume is more than 5 mL, and each fish only draws blood once.
statement: 使用5毫升一次性无菌注射器从鲫鱼尾静脉抽血，血量超过5毫升，且每条鱼只抽血一次。
text_zh: 使用5毫升一次性无菌注射器从鲫鱼尾静脉抽血，血量超过5毫升，且每条鱼只抽血一次。
text_en: Blood was drawn from the caudal vein of crucian carp using a 5 mL disposable sterile syringe, with a blood volume exceeding 5 mL, and each fish was bled only once.

quote: This finding is consistent with research results on Oncorhynchus mykiss anesthetized with myrcene and eugenol [ 38 ].
statement: 这一发现与使用月桂烯和丁香酚麻醉虹鳟的研究结果一致。
text_zh: 这一发现与使用月桂烯和丁香酚麻醉虹鳟的研究结果一致。
text_en: This finding is consistent with the results of studies using myrcene and eugenol to anesthetize rainbow trout.

quote: Feng et al. [ 41 ] have found that the serum phosphorus and magnesium levels of juvenile Siberian sturgeon (Acipenser baerii) increase after eugenol anesthesia, similar to the results of this study.
statement: Feng等人发现，西伯利亚鲟幼鱼在丁香酚麻醉后血清磷和镁水平升高，这与本研究的结果相似。
text_zh: Feng等人发现，西伯利亚鲟幼鱼在丁香酚麻醉后血清磷和镁水平升高，这与本研究的结果相似。
text_en: Feng et al. found that serum phosphorus and magnesium levels increased in Siberian sturgeon juveniles after eugenol anesthesia, which is similar to the results of this study.

quote: We speculated that with increasing eugenol concentration, the damage to the fish kidneys caused by the anesthetic was aggravated, thus resulting in renal dysfunction, abnormal magnesium metabolism, and serum magnesium retention and increased level.
statement: 作者推测，随着丁香酚浓度的增加，麻醉剂对鱼肾脏造成的损伤加剧，从而导致肾功能不全、镁代谢异常以及血清镁滞留和水平升高。
text_zh: 作者推测，随着丁香酚浓度的增加，麻醉剂对鱼肾脏造成的损伤加剧，从而导致肾功能不全、镁代谢异常以及血清镁滞留和水平升高。
text_en: The authors speculated that as the concentration of eugenol increased, the damage to fish kidneys caused by the anesthetic worsened, leading to renal insufficiency, magnesium metabolism abnormalities, and serum magnesium retention and elevated levels.
counterevidence: 高浓度可能导致肾损伤

quote: We inferred that eugenol anesthesia in crucian carp increased the permeability of the gill epithelium.
statement: 作者推断，鲫鱼的丁香酚麻醉增加了鳃上皮的通透性。
text_zh: 作者推断，鲫鱼的丁香酚麻醉增加了鳃上皮的通透性。
text_en: The authors inferred that eugenol anesthesia in crucian carp increased the permeability of the gill epithelium.
counterevidence: 通透性增加可能影响离子平衡

quote: Excessive Na + entered the blood, and its concentration significantly increased, whereas K + was inhibited, and its concentration significantly decreased.
statement: 过多的Na+进入血液，其浓度显著增加，而K+受到抑制，其浓度显著降低。
text_zh: 过多的Na+进入血液，其浓度显著增加，而K+受到抑制，其浓度显著降低。
text_en: Excessive Na+ enters the blood, its concentration increases significantly, while K+ is inhibited, and its concentration decreases significantly.
counterevidence: 钠钾离子浓度发生显著不利变化

quote: The LDH content in the control group was 531.67 ± 13.67 U/L, and the highest LDH in the 80 mg/L group was 2560 ± 17 U/L.
statement: 对照组LDH含量为531.67 ± 13.67 U/L，80 mg/L组最高LDH为2560 ± 17 U/L。
text_en: 对照组LDH含量为531.67 ± 13.67 U/L，80 mg/L组最高LDH为2560 ± 17 U/L。

quote: A significant difference was observed between the experimental group and the control group (p Figure 2 B). The concentration of ALP in the control group was 11.32 ± 3.46 U/L.
statement: 实验组与对照组之间观察到显著差异（图2B）。对照组ALP浓度为11.32 ± 3.46 U/L。
text_zh: 实验组与对照组之间观察到显著差异（图2B）。对照组ALP浓度为11.32 ± 3.46 U/L。
text_en: A significant difference was observed between the experimental and control groups (Figure 2B). The ALP concentration in the control group was 11.32 ± 3.46 U/L.

quote: A significant difference was observed between the control group and the 60, 70, and 80 mg/L test groups (p p > 0.05).
statement: 对照组与60、70和80 mg/L试验组之间观察到显著差异（原文此处统计描述存在矛盾或排版错误）。
text_zh: 对照组与60、70和80 mg/L试验组之间观察到显著差异（原文此处统计描述存在矛盾或排版错误）。
text_en: Significant differences were observed between the control group and the 60, 70, and 80 mg/L treatment groups (the statistical description in the original text contains a contradiction or typesetting error).

quote: The serum K + concentration in each experimental group after anesthesia was lower than that in the control group (Figure 3 B). A significant difference in serum K + concentration was observed between the experimental group and the control group (p 2+ in the serum in the control group was 1.60 ± 0.13 mmol/L, whereas that in each experimental group after anesthesia was higher (Figure 3 C).
statement: 麻醉后各实验组血清K+浓度低于对照组，且与对照组有显著差异；对照组血清Mg2+为1.60 ± 0.13 mmol/L，麻醉后各实验组Mg2+浓度较高。
text_zh: 麻醉后各实验组血清K+浓度低于对照组，且与对照组有显著差异；对照组血清Mg2+为1.60 ± 0.13 mmol/L，麻醉后各实验组Mg2+浓度较高。
text_en: After anesthesia, serum K+ concentrations in all experimental groups were lower than those in the control group, with a significant difference from the control group; serum Mg2+ in the control group was 1.60 ± 0.13 mmol/L, and Mg2+ concentrations in all experimental groups after anesthesia were higher.

quote: In this study, the serum triglyceride content in crucian carp in the experimental groups was lower than that in the control group, whereas the total cholesterol content in the experimental groups did not significantly differ from that in the control group, in agreement with the results of eugenol anesthesia in short-tailed bass (Piaractus brachypomus) [ 19 ].
statement: 本研究中，实验组鲫鱼的血清甘油三酯含量低于对照组，而总胆固醇含量与对照组无显著差异，这与丁香酚麻醉短吻脂鲤的结果一致。
text_zh: 本研究中，实验组鲫鱼的血清甘油三酯含量低于对照组，而总胆固醇含量与对照组无显著差异，这与丁香酚麻醉短吻脂鲤的结果一致。
text_en: In this study, serum triglyceride content in crucian carp in the experimental group was lower than that in the control group, while total cholesterol content showed no significant difference from the control group, which is consistent with results for eugenol anesthesia in shortnose tetras.
outcome: 血液脂质代谢（甘油三酯、总胆固醇）
counterevidence: 总胆固醇含量无显著差异

quote: The reason for the decrease may be that under anesthesia, blood lipids are involved in metabolism and are transported and decomposed.
statement: 甘油三酯下降的原因可能是麻醉状态下血脂参与代谢并被运输和分解。
text_zh: 甘油三酯下降的原因可能是麻醉状态下血脂参与代谢并被运输和分解。
text_en: The reason for the decrease in triglycerides may be that blood lipids participate in metabolism and are transported and broken down under anesthesia.

quote: Muscle glycogen, an important energy source for maintaining the body’s metabolism, exists primarily in muscles and is an important indicator of the degree of environmental stress.
statement: 肌糖原是维持身体代谢的重要能量来源，主要存在于肌肉中，是环境应激程度的重要指标。
text_zh: 肌糖原是维持身体代谢的重要能量来源，主要存在于肌肉中，是环境应激程度的重要指标。
text_en: Muscle glycogen is an important energy source for maintaining body metabolism, mainly existing in muscles, and is an important indicator of the degree of environmental stress.

quote: This ﬁsh is a vector for a lot of diseases, which can easily spread over for other species.
statement: Az ezüstkárász számos betegség vektora, amelyek könnyen átterjedhetnek más fajokra.
text_en: Az ezüstkárász számos betegség vektora, amelyek könnyen átterjedhetnek más fajokra.

quote: In this experiment, we observed no overlap between the control group and the groups subjected to different concentrations of eugenol anesthesia; however, overlap existed between the experimental groups, possibly because of the minor effects of eugenol on the flavor substances in crucian carp muscle.
statement: 本实验中，对照组与不同浓度丁香酚麻醉组之间无重叠，但实验组之间存在重叠，这可能归因于丁香酚对鲫鱼肌肉风味物质的轻微影响。
text_zh: 本实验中，对照组与不同浓度丁香酚麻醉组之间无重叠，但实验组之间存在重叠，这可能归因于丁香酚对鲫鱼肌肉风味物质的轻微影响。
text_en: In this experiment, there was no overlap between the control group and the eugenol anesthesia groups at different concentrations, but overlaps existed among the experimental groups, which may be attributed to the slight effect of eugenol on the flavor substances in crucian carp muscle.

quote: According to the changes in blood physiological and biochemical indexes in crucian carp after eugenol anesthesia, we determined that 20–80 mg/L concentrations of eugenol had relatively small effects on the physiological and biochemical indexes, but relatively greater effects on muscle, and did not result in major liver histomorphological effects.
statement: 根据鲫鱼在丁香酚麻醉后血液生理生化指标的变化，确定20-80 mg/L浓度的丁香酚对生理生化指标影响较小，但对肌肉影响较大，且未导致主要的肝脏组织形态学效应。
text_zh: 根据鲫鱼在丁香酚麻醉后血液生理生化指标的变化，确定20-80 mg/L浓度的丁香酚对生理生化指标影响较小，但对肌肉影响较大，且未导致主要的肝脏组织形态学效应。
text_en: Based on changes in blood physiological and biochemical indicators of crucian carp after eugenol anesthesia, it was determined that eugenol at a concentration of 20-80 mg/L had little effect on physiological and biochemical indicators, but had a greater effect on muscle, and did not cause major morphological effects on liver tissue.
outcome: 生理生化指标、肌肉状态及肝脏组织形态

quote: However, the edema observed in a very small number of gill lamellae requires further study to determine any potential histological effects of this anesthesia method.
statement: 然而，在极少数鳃丝中观察到的水肿需要进一步研究，以确定这种麻醉方法可能产生的组织学效应。
text_zh: 然而，在极少数鳃丝中观察到的水肿需要进一步研究，以确定这种麻醉方法可能产生的组织学效应。
text_en: However, edema observed in a very small number of gill filaments requires further study to determine the histological effects that this anesthetic method may produce.
limitations: 仅在极少数样本中观察到

quote: This finding is inconsistent with that reported by Hu et al. [ 42 ], who have found that the serum K + level in silver carp (Hypophthalmichthys molitrix) increases by four times after CO 2 anesthesia.
statement: 该发现与Hu等人报道的二氧化碳麻醉后鲢鱼血清钾水平增加四倍的结果不一致。
text_zh: 该发现与Hu等人报道的二氧化碳麻醉后鲢鱼血清钾水平增加四倍的结果不一致。
text_en: This finding is inconsistent with the result reported by Hu et al. of a fourfold increase in serum potassium levels in silver carp after CO2 anesthesia.

quote: Therefore, differences in the mechanisms of various anesthesia methods may exist among fish species, and the physiological functions of serum ions with different anesthesia methods must be further explored.
statement: 因此，不同鱼类物种间各种麻醉方法的机制可能存在差异，且不同麻醉方法下血清离子的生理功能需进一步探索。
text_zh: 因此，不同鱼类物种间各种麻醉方法的机制可能存在差异，且不同麻醉方法下血清离子的生理功能需进一步探索。
text_en: Therefore, the mechanisms of various anesthetic methods may differ among fish species, and the physiological functions of serum ions under different anesthetic methods require further exploration.

quote: The blood GLU concentration in crucian carp in the control group was lower than that in each group after anesthesia.
statement: 对照组鲫鱼的血糖浓度低于麻醉后各组。
text_zh: 对照组鲫鱼的血糖浓度低于麻醉后各组。
text_en: The blood glucose concentration of crucian carp in the control group was lower than that in all groups after anesthesia.

quote: This finding might have been due to a decrease in blood GLU metabolism after anesthesia, thereby increasing the blood GLU concentration.
statement: 这一发现可能是由于麻醉后血糖代谢减少，从而导致血糖浓度升高。
text_zh: 这一发现可能是由于麻醉后血糖代谢减少，从而导致血糖浓度升高。
text_en: This finding may be due to reduced blood glucose metabolism after anesthesia, leading to elevated blood glucose concentrations.

quote: After anesthesia with eugenol, the ALB value in crucian carp decreased, possibly because ALB, as a carrier of nutrients, increased consumption when dealing with the anesthesia slope, thus providing energy for the body, repairing damaged tissues, and participating in maintaining plasma colloid osmotic pressure balance.
statement: 丁香酚麻醉后，鲫鱼的白蛋白值下降，可能是因为作为营养载体的白蛋白在应对麻醉过程时消耗增加，从而为身体提供能量、修复受损组织并参与维持血浆胶体渗透压平衡。
text_zh: 丁香酚麻醉后，鲫鱼的白蛋白值下降，可能是因为作为营养载体的白蛋白在应对麻醉过程时消耗增加，从而为身体提供能量、修复受损组织并参与维持血浆胶体渗透压平衡。
text_en: After eugenol anesthesia, the albumin values of crucian carp decreased, possibly because albumin, as a nutrient carrier, was consumed more during the response to the anesthesia process, thereby providing energy for the body, repairing damaged tissues, and participating in maintaining plasma colloid osmotic pressure balance.

quote: all of them were anesthetized with 20 mg/L MS-222 (Sigma, Alcobendas, Spain) and sacrificed before examination
statement: 所有三倍体鲫鱼在检查前均使用20 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉并被处死。
text_zh: 所有三倍体鲫鱼在检查前均使用20 mg/L的MS-222进行麻醉并被处死。
text_en: All triploid crucian carp were anesthetized with 20 mg/L MS-222 and euthanized before examination.

quote: Xue M., Cui Y. 2001: Effect of several feeding stimulants on diet preference by juvenile giebel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio), feed diets with or without partial replacement of ﬁsh meal by meat and bone meat. Aquaculture Vol 198. 281-292p
statement: A tanulmány etésstimulánsok hatását és a halhús részleges helyettesítését vizsgálta hús- és csontliszttel az ifjú ezüstkárász étrend-preferenciájára.
text_en: A tanulmány etésstimulánsok hatását és a halhús részleges helyettesítését vizsgálta hús- és csontliszttel az ifjú ezüstkárász étrend-preferenciájára.

population.species: ifjú ezüstkárász (juvenile giebel carp, Carassius auratus gibelio)

intervention: Feeding stimulants and meat and bone meal

quote: Wang G.T., Yao W.J., Wang Y.G., Lu Y.S. 2001: Occurrence of theleohanellosis caused by Thelohanellus wuhanensis (Myxosphora) in juvenile allogynogenethic silver crucian carp (Carassius auratus gibelio Bloch), with an observation on the efﬁcacy of fumagillin as a therapeutant. Journal of Fish diseases, Vol 24. No 1. 57-60p
statement: A tanulmány a Thelohanellus wuhanensis által okozott teleohanellózis előfordulását és a fumagillin terápiás hatékonyságát vizsgálta alloginogenetikus ezüstkárász ivadékoknál.
text_en: A tanulmány a Thelohanellus wuhanensis által okozott teleohanellózis előfordulását és a fumagillin terápiás hatékonyságát vizsgálta alloginogenetikus ezüstkárász ivadékoknál.
