quote: 3.6. AMPs Improve the Resistance of the Intestinal Ecosystem to Aeromonas hydrophila Infection
statement: AMPs提高了肠道生态系统对嗜水气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_zh: AMPs提高了肠道生态系统对嗜水气单胞菌感染的抵抗力。
text_en: AMPs improved the resistance of the gut ecosystem to Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: 3.6.1. AMPs Reduce Intestinal Damage after Aeromonas hydrophila Infection
statement: AMPs减少了嗜水气单胞菌感染后的肠道损伤。
text_zh: AMPs减少了嗜水气单胞菌感染后的肠道损伤。
text_en: AMPs reduced intestinal damage after Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: In high-density aquaculture, fish are under immense pressure due to crowding stress, resulting in slow growth and weakened immunity.
statement: 高密度养殖中的拥挤压力导致鱼类生长缓慢和免疫力减弱。
text_zh: 高密度养殖中的拥挤压力导致鱼类生长缓慢和免疫力减弱。
text_en: Crowding stress in high-density farming leads to slow fish growth and weakened immunity.

quote: we tested whether adding natural green tea extracts (tea polyphenols) to fish feed could help hybrid crucian carp cope with overcrowding.
statement: 研究测试了在饲料中添加天然绿茶提取物（茶多酚）是否有助于杂交鲫鱼应对过度拥挤。
text_zh: 研究测试了在饲料中添加天然绿茶提取物（茶多酚）是否有助于杂交鲫鱼应对过度拥挤。
text_en: The study tested whether adding natural green tea extract (tea polyphenols) to the feed helps hybrid crucian carp cope with overcrowding.

quote: fish receiving 200 mg/kg of tea polyphenols showed remarkable improvements; they grew faster than stressed fish without additives, developed stronger internal defenses against stress damage, processed fats more efficiently, and maintained healthier gut microbiota.
statement: 接受200 mg/kg茶多酚的鱼类表现出显著改善，比未添加添加剂的应激鱼生长更快，对压力损伤的内部防御更强，脂肪处理效率更高，并维持了更健康的肠道菌群。
text_zh: 接受200 mg/kg茶多酚的鱼类表现出显著改善，比未添加添加剂的应激鱼生长更快，对压力损伤的内部防御更强，脂肪处理效率更高，并维持了更健康的肠道菌群。
text_en: Fish receiving 200 mg/kg tea polyphenols showed significant improvements, growing faster than stressed fish without additives, having stronger internal defenses against stress damage, higher fat processing efficiency, and maintaining healthier gut microbiota.
outcome: 生长性能、抗应激能力、脂质代谢及肠道微生物群

quote: By naturally boosting fish health in crowded conditions, tea polyphenols offer fish farmers a safe, eco-friendly alternative to antibiotics and chemicals.
statement: 通过自然增强拥挤条件下的鱼类健康，茶多酚为渔民提供了抗生素和化学品的安全、环保替代品。
text_zh: 通过自然增强拥挤条件下的鱼类健康，茶多酚为渔民提供了抗生素和化学品的安全、环保替代品。
text_en: By naturally enhancing fish health under crowded conditions, tea polyphenols provide fishermen with a safe and environmentally friendly alternative to antibiotics and chemicals.
outcome: 整体健康状况及减少药物依赖

quote: Aeromonas hydrophila infection had a significant effect on intestinal goblet cell abundance (Table S3) (Figure S2). Changes in goblet cell abundance were observed in all infected groups.
statement: 嗜水气单胞菌感染对肠道杯状细胞丰度有显著影响，所有感染组均观察到杯状细胞丰度的变化。
text_zh: 嗜水气单胞菌感染对肠道杯状细胞丰度有显著影响，所有感染组均观察到杯状细胞丰度的变化。
text_en: Aeromonas hydrophila infection had a significant effect on intestinal goblet cell abundance; changes in goblet cell abundance were observed in all infected groups.

quote: Intestinal goblet cell abundance was increased in the G0 group compared to the PBS control group, and significant differences were observed in the midgut and hindgut (p p > 0.05), and the number of goblet cells in the G3 group was significantly lower than that in the G0 group (p
statement: 与PBS对照组相比，G0组的肠道杯状细胞丰度增加；G3组的杯状细胞数量显著低于G0组。
text_zh: 与PBS对照组相比，G0组的肠道杯状细胞丰度增加；G3组的杯状细胞数量显著低于G0组。
text_en: Compared with the PBS control group, the abundance of intestinal goblet cells in the G0 group increased; the number of goblet cells in the G3 group was significantly lower than that in the G0 group.
counterevidence: G3组杯状细胞数量显著低于G0组

quote: Aeromonas hydrophila infection resulted in enhanced immune gene expression in all groups compared to the PBS control group (Figure 5).
statement: 与PBS对照组相比，嗜水气单胞菌感染导致所有组的免疫基因表达增强。
text_zh: 与PBS对照组相比，嗜水气单胞菌感染导致所有组的免疫基因表达增强。
text_en: Compared with the PBS control group, Aeromonas hydrophila infection led to enhanced immune gene expression in all groups.

quote: Compared with the G0 group, the expression of TLR-4 , MYD88 , as well as TNF-α in the AMP-supplemented groups was lower (Figure 5 A–C), and there was a significant difference in the G3 group (p
statement: 与G0组相比，补充抗菌肽的组中TLR-4、MYD88和TNF-α的表达较低，且G3组存在显著差异。
text_zh: 与G0组相比，补充抗菌肽的组中TLR-4、MYD88和TNF-α的表达较低，且G3组存在显著差异。
text_en: Compared to the G0 group, the expression of TLR-4, MYD88 and TNF-α was lower in the groups supplemented with antimicrobial peptides, and a significant difference existed in the G3 group.

quote: In contrast, the relative expression of IL-10 and IL-11 was increased in those groups compared to the G0 group (Figure 5 D,E). The expression level in the G3 group had considerably greater levels than the G0 group (p
statement: 相反，与G0组相比，这些组中IL-10和IL-11的相对表达量增加，且G3组的表达水平远高于G0组。
text_zh: 相反，与G0组相比，这些组中IL-10和IL-11的相对表达量增加，且G3组的表达水平远高于G0组。
text_en: In contrast, compared with the G0 group, the relative expression levels of IL-10 and IL-11 increased in these groups, and the expression level in the G3 group was much higher than that in the G0 group.

quote: 3.6.3. AMPs Ameliorate Intestinal Microbiota Diversity after Aeromonas hydrophila Infection
statement: 抗菌肽改善了嗜水气单胞菌感染后的肠道微生物群多样性。
text_zh: 抗菌肽改善了嗜水气单胞菌感染后的肠道微生物群多样性。
text_en: Antimicrobial peptides improved the diversity of the gut microbiota after Aeromonas hydrophila infection.

quote: The results demonstrate that different doses of AMP supplementation can boost antioxidant capacity in the intestine.
statement: 结果表明，不同剂量的AMP补充可以提高肠道的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 结果表明，不同剂量的AMP补充可以提高肠道的抗氧化能力。
text_en: The results showed that supplementation with different doses of AMP can improve the antioxidant capacity of the intestine.

quote: Compared with G0 animals, the activities of T-AOC and SOD in G3 animals were substantially increased (p p > 0.05).
statement: 与G0动物相比，G3动物中T-AOC和SOD的活性显著增加（注：原文统计符号存在矛盾，显示p>0.05但描述为substantially increased）。
text_zh: 与G0动物相比，G3动物中T-AOC和SOD的活性显著增加（注：原文统计符号存在矛盾，显示p>0.05但描述为substantially increased）。
text_en: Compared to G0 animals, the activities of T-AOC and SOD in G3 animals were significantly increased (Note: The statistical symbols in the original text are contradictory, showing p>0.05 but described as substantially increased).
counterevidence: 统计值p>0.05通常表示不显著，与文字描述矛盾

quote: The activity of MDA in the G3 group was substantially downregulated compared with that in the G0 group (p p
statement: 与G0组相比，G3组中MDA的活性显著下调。
text_zh: 与G0组相比，G3组中MDA的活性显著下调。
text_en: Compared to the G0 group, MDA activity was significantly downregulated in the G3 group.

quote: IL-10 (Figure 1 D) and IL-11 (Figure 1 E) in all groups except in the G1 group, with the lowest relative expression in the G3 group (p
statement: 除G1组外，所有组别中IL-10和IL-11的表达情况，其中G3组的相对表达量最低。
text_zh: 除G1组外，所有组别中IL-10和IL-11的表达情况，其中G3组的相对表达量最低。
text_en: Expression of IL-10 and IL-11 in all groups except G1, with the lowest relative expression in group G3.

quote: The antioxidant-related parameters [total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC, ABTS reduction method), superoxide dismutase (SOD, WST-8 inhibition method), catalase (CAT, Molybdate assay method), and glutathione (GSH, DTNB reaction method)] in serum and liver tissue were measured according to the protocols provided by Beijing Boxbio Science & Technology Co., Ltd. (Beijing, China).
statement: 血清和肝组织中的抗氧化相关参数（总抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽）按照北京博奥森生物技术有限公司提供的方案进行测量。
text_zh: 血清和肝组织中的抗氧化相关参数（总抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽）按照北京博奥森生物技术有限公司提供的方案进行测量。
text_en: Antioxidant-related parameters in serum and liver tissue (total antioxidant capacity, superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione) were measured according to the protocol provided by Beijing Biosharp Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
intervention_record: 抗氧化指标试剂盒检测

quote: Previous research has shown that AMPs influence the gut and change the composition of the gut microbiota.
statement: 先前的研究表明，抗菌肽（AMPs）会影响肠道并改变肠道微生物群的组成。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，抗菌肽（AMPs）会影响肠道并改变肠道微生物群的组成。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) affect the gut and alter the composition of the gut microbiota.

quote: The expression of intestinal immune factors is closely related to the abundance of beneficial bacteria, indicating that Proteobacteria, Verrucomicrobia and Nitrospirae can suppress inflammation and improve intestinal immunity.
statement: 肠道免疫因子的表达与有益菌的丰度密切相关，表明变形菌门、疣微菌门和硝化螺旋菌门可以抑制炎症并改善肠道免疫力。
text_zh: 肠道免疫因子的表达与有益菌的丰度密切相关，表明变形菌门、疣微菌门和硝化螺旋菌门可以抑制炎症并改善肠道免疫力。
text_en: The expression of intestinal immune factors is closely related to the abundance of beneficial bacteria, indicating that Proteobacteria, Verrucomicrobia, and Nitrospirae can inhibit inflammation and improve intestinal immunity.

quote: The inhibition of the diversity of intestinal bacteria is linked to the fact that high dosages of AMPs eventually have a suppressive impact on intestinal immunity.
statement: 肠道细菌多样性的抑制与高剂量抗菌肽最终对肠道免疫产生抑制作用这一事实有关。
text_zh: 肠道细菌多样性的抑制与高剂量抗菌肽最终对肠道免疫产生抑制作用这一事实有关。
text_en: The inhibition of intestinal bacterial diversity is related to the fact that high-dose antimicrobial peptides ultimately inhibit intestinal immunity.
counterevidence: 高剂量可能抑制肠道免疫

quote: We hypothesize that high concentrations of AMPs may influence good bacteria while inhibiting bad bacteria.
statement: 我们假设高浓度的抗菌肽可能在抑制有害细菌的同时影响有益细菌。
text_zh: 我们假设高浓度的抗菌肽可能在抑制有害细菌的同时影响有益细菌。
text_en: We hypothesize that high concentrations of antimicrobial peptides may affect beneficial bacteria while inhibiting harmful bacteria.

quote: Following Aeromonas hydrophila infection, the analysis of the gut’s microbial diversity revealed that the G5 group had the greatest diversity.
statement: 在嗜水气单胞菌感染后，对肠道微生物多样性的分析显示G5组具有最大的多样性。
text_zh: 在嗜水气单胞菌感染后，对肠道微生物多样性的分析显示G5组具有最大的多样性。
text_en: After Aeromonas hydrophila infection, analysis of intestinal microbial diversity showed that the G5 group had the greatest diversity.

population.species: 嗜水气单胞菌感染模型 (未明确宿主物种，但提及感染)

quote: This further establishes the possibility that the dose may be positively correlated with the inhibitory action of AMPs on dangerous bacteria.
statement: 这进一步证实了剂量可能与抗菌肽对危险细菌的抑制作用呈正相关的可能性。
text_zh: 这进一步证实了剂量可能与抗菌肽对危险细菌的抑制作用呈正相关的可能性。
text_en: This further confirms the possibility that the dose may be positively correlated with the inhibitory effect of antimicrobial peptides on hazardous bacteria.

quote: However, the potent antibacterial effects of high-dose AMPs will have a detrimental effect on the uninfected gut, perhaps reducing both hazardous and beneficial bacteria.
statement: 然而，高剂量抗菌肽的强效抗菌作用将对未感染的肠道产生不利影响，可能会同时减少有害菌和有益菌。
text_zh: 然而，高剂量抗菌肽的强效抗菌作用将对未感染的肠道产生不利影响，可能会同时减少有害菌和有益菌。
text_en: However, the strong antibacterial effect of high-dose antimicrobial peptides will adversely affect uninfected intestines, potentially reducing both harmful and beneficial bacteria.
counterevidence: 高剂量可能损害未感染肠道的菌群平衡

quote: In summary, we can boldly infer that AMPs can directly and indirectly improve intestinal function.
statement: 总之，我们可以大胆推断抗菌肽可以直接和间接地改善肠道功能。
text_zh: 总之，我们可以大胆推断抗菌肽可以直接和间接地改善肠道功能。
text_en: In summary, we can boldly infer that antimicrobial peptides can directly and indirectly improve intestinal function.

quote: They can also maintain intestinal homeostasis and intestinal functional integrity by regulating the activity of intestinal antioxidant enzymes through the inflammatory response.
statement: 它们还可以通过炎症反应调节肠道抗氧化酶的活性来维持肠道稳态和肠道功能完整性。
text_zh: 它们还可以通过炎症反应调节肠道抗氧化酶的活性来维持肠道稳态和肠道功能完整性。
text_en: They can also maintain intestinal homeostasis and intestinal functional integrity by regulating the activity of intestinal antioxidant enzymes through inflammatory responses.

quote: Serum levels of energy metabolism indicators [lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), glucose (GLU), and lactate (LACT)], lipid metabolism indicators [triglycerides (TG), total cholesterol (TC), non-esterified fatty acids (NEFA), low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), and high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C)], and immune-related indicators [albumin (ALB), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and alkaline phosphatase (ALP)] were measured using a Roche cobas-c-311 fully automatic biochemical analyzer
statement: 使用全自动生化分析仪测量血清中的能量代谢、脂质代谢和免疫相关指标水平。
text_zh: 使用全自动生化分析仪测量血清中的能量代谢、脂质代谢和免疫相关指标水平。
text_en: Serum levels of energy metabolism, lipid metabolism, and immune-related indicators were measured using a fully automated biochemical analyzer.

quote: ered considerable attention owing to their anti-stress properties [ 17 ].
statement: TPs因其抗应激特性而受到关注。
text_zh: TPs因其抗应激特性而受到关注。
text_en: TPs have attracted attention due to their anti-stress properties.

quote: TPs effectively protected grass carp against Flavobacterium columnare-induced gill injury by suppressing oxidative stress, apoptosis, and inflammation, while enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity and immune responses [ 18 ].
statement: TPs通过抑制氧化应激、细胞凋亡和炎症，并增强抗氧化酶活性和免疫反应，有效保护草鱼免受柱状黄杆菌诱导的鳃损伤。
text_zh: TPs通过抑制氧化应激、细胞凋亡和炎症，并增强抗氧化酶活性和免疫反应，有效保护草鱼免受柱状黄杆菌诱导的鳃损伤。
text_en: TPs effectively protect grass carp from gill injury induced by Flavobacterium columnare by inhibiting oxidative stress, apoptosis, and inflammation, and enhancing antioxidant enzyme activity and immune response.

quote: Similarly, dietary TPs in the diet effectively mitigated oxidative damage induced by ammonia exposure in juvenile Wuchang bream (Megalobrama amblycephala), primarily through the enhancement of their antioxidant defense mechanisms and immune functions [ 19 ].
statement: 日粮中的TPs主要通过增强武昌鱼幼鱼的抗氧化防御机制和免疫功能，有效缓解了氨暴露诱导的氧化损伤。
text_zh: 日粮中的TPs主要通过增强武昌鱼幼鱼的抗氧化防御机制和免疫功能，有效缓解了氨暴露诱导的氧化损伤。
text_en: Dietary TPs effectively alleviated ammonia exposure-induced oxidative damage in juvenile Wuchang bream mainly by enhancing antioxidant defense mechanisms and immune function.

quote: Further, the supplementation TPs in oxidized fish-oil-based feed improves intestinal morphology, promotes the enrichment of beneficial gut microbiota, and optimizes hepatic nutrient metabolism in spotted sea bass (Lateolabrax maculatus) [ 20 ].
statement: 在氧化鱼油基础饲料中添加TPs改善了花鲈的肠道形态，促进了有益肠道菌群的富集，并优化了肝脏营养代谢。
text_zh: 在氧化鱼油基础饲料中添加TPs改善了花鲈的肠道形态，促进了有益肠道菌群的富集，并优化了肝脏营养代谢。
text_en: Adding TPs to oxidized fish oil-based feed improved the intestinal morphology of Lateolabrax maculatus, promoted the enrichment of beneficial gut microbiota, and optimized hepatic nutrient metabolism.
intervention: Tea polyphenols in oxidized fish oil diet
intervention_record: 氧化鱼油饲料补充茶多酚

quote: Moreover, TPs restructured the intestinal microbiota composition in loaches (Paramisgurnus dabryanus) under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress, specifically enriching metabolic pathways linked to amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis, thereby providing a potential mechanism for microbial-mediated adaptation to environmental stressors [ 21 ].
statement: 此外，TPs重构了慢性氨氮胁迫下泥鳅的肠道微生物群组成，特异性地富集了与氨基酸和核苷酸生物合成相关的代谢途径，从而为微生物介导的环境胁迫适应提供了潜在机制。
text_zh: 此外，TPs重构了慢性氨氮胁迫下泥鳅的肠道微生物群组成，特异性地富集了与氨基酸和核苷酸生物合成相关的代谢途径，从而为微生物介导的环境胁迫适应提供了潜在机制。
text_en: In addition, TPs restructured the gut microbiota composition of loach under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress, specifically enriching metabolic pathways related to amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis, thereby providing a potential mechanism for microbe-mediated environmental stress adaptation.

quote: However, under crowding stress (CS group), the relative abundance of Proteobacteria increased to 37.1%, whereas Firmicutes decreased to 12.9%.
statement: 在拥挤胁迫条件下，变形菌门的相对丰度增加至37.1%，而厚壁菌门减少至12.9%。
text_zh: 在拥挤胁迫条件下，变形菌门的相对丰度增加至37.1%，而厚壁菌门减少至12.9%。
text_en: Under crowding stress conditions, the relative abundance of Proteobacteria increased to 37.1%, while Firmicutes decreased to 12.9%.

quote: In the treatment groups (CSLTP, CSMTP, and CSHTP), the proportion of Firmicutes partially recovered to 14.0–21.6%, while the abundance of Proteobacteria remained largely unchanged compared to the CS group.
statement: 在处理组中，厚壁菌门的比例部分恢复至14.0–21.6%，而变形菌门的丰度与拥挤胁迫组相比基本保持不变。
text_zh: 在处理组中，厚壁菌门的比例部分恢复至14.0–21.6%，而变形菌门的丰度与拥挤胁迫组相比基本保持不变。
text_en: In the treatment group, the proportion of Firmicutes partially recovered to 14.0–21.6%, while the abundance of Proteobacteria remained largely unchanged compared to the crowding stress group.

quote: Compared with the control group (CON) under low-density rearing conditions, the oxidative stress level in the crowded stress group (CS) under high-density rearing conditions significantly increased, as evidenced by elevated serum T-AOC
statement: 在高密度养殖条件下，拥挤应激组的氧化应激水平显著增加，表现为血清总抗氧化能力升高。
text_zh: 在高密度养殖条件下，拥挤应激组的氧化应激水平显著增加，表现为血清总抗氧化能力升高。
text_en: Under high-density farming conditions, the oxidative stress level in the crowding stress group increased significantly, manifested as an increase in serum total antioxidant capacity.

quote: compared with the control group (CON), the crowding stress group (CS) exhibited significantly increased expression of SOD , CPT1 , and dgat2 in the liver
statement: 与对照组相比，拥挤应激组肝脏中SOD、CPT1和dgat2的表达显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，拥挤应激组肝脏中SOD、CPT1和dgat2的表达显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the expression of SOD, CPT1 and dgat2 in the liver was significantly increased in the crowding stress group.

quote: Compared to its predecessor, Hefang crucian carp I (Carassius auratus cuvieri ♀ × Carassius auratus red var ♂, HCC1), HCC2 demonstrates a growth rate that is approximately 60% higher than HCC1, as evidenced by the final body weight (556 g vs. 380 g) after the first year of observation
statement: 与合方鲫鱼I相比，合方鲫鱼II的生长速度高出约60%，第一年末体重分别为556克和380克。
text_zh: 与合方鲫鱼I相比，合方鲫鱼II的生长速度高出约60%，第一年末体重分别为556克和380克。
text_en: Compared with He Fang Crucian Carp I, the growth rate of He Fang Crucian Carp II was about 60% higher, with body weights at the end of the first year being 556 grams and 380 grams, respectively.

quote: However, high stocking densities can exert various adverse effects on fish, affecting their health, behavior, and overall well-being.
statement: 高放养密度会对鱼类产生多种不利影响，影响其健康、行为和整体福利。
text_zh: 高放养密度会对鱼类产生多种不利影响，影响其健康、行为和整体福利。
text_en: High stocking density has multiple adverse effects on fish, affecting their health, behavior, and overall welfare.

quote: The optimal stocking density for HCC2 remains unclear, which poses challenges to both fish welfare and aquaculture productivity
statement: 合方鲫鱼II的最佳放养密度尚不明确，这对鱼类福利和水产养殖生产力构成了挑战。
text_zh: 合方鲫鱼II的最佳放养密度尚不明确，这对鱼类福利和水产养殖生产力构成了挑战。
text_en: The optimal stocking density for He Fang Crucian Carp II is not yet clear, which poses a challenge to fish welfare and aquaculture productivity.

quote: Intensification involves increasing the density of individuals, which necessitates greater management of inputs, increased waste production, and heightened risk of pathogen transmission
statement: 集约化涉及增加个体密度，这需要更多的投入管理、产生更多废物并增加病原体传播风险。
text_zh: 集约化涉及增加个体密度，这需要更多的投入管理、产生更多废物并增加病原体传播风险。
text_en: Intensification involves increasing individual density, which requires more input management, generates more waste and increases the risk of pathogen transmission.

quote: Extensive research demonstrates that crowding stress markedly impairs the immune system of fish, thereby increasing their vulnerability to various diseases
statement: 广泛的研究表明，拥挤应激会显著损害鱼类的免疫系统，从而增加其对各种疾病的易感性。
text_zh: 广泛的研究表明，拥挤应激会显著损害鱼类的免疫系统，从而增加其对各种疾病的易感性。
text_en: Extensive research has shown that crowding stress significantly impairs the immune system of fish, thereby increasing their susceptibility to various diseases.
outcome: 免疫功能与疾病易感性

quote: Chronic stress in fish is associated with the downregulation of key components within the hypothalamic–pituitary–inter-renal (HPI) axis, such as adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) or corticosteroid receptors, resulting in a compromised cortisol response
statement: 鱼类慢性应激与下丘脑-垂体-间肾（HPI）轴关键组分（如促肾上腺皮质激素或皮质类固醇受体）的下调有关，导致皮质醇反应受损。
text_zh: 鱼类慢性应激与下丘脑-垂体-间肾（HPI）轴关键组分（如促肾上腺皮质激素或皮质类固醇受体）的下调有关，导致皮质醇反应受损。
text_en: Chronic stress in fish is associated with the downregulation of key components of the hypothalamic-pituitary-interrenal (HPI) axis, such as adrenocorticotropic hormone or corticosteroid receptors, leading to impaired cortisol responses.

quote: Furthermore, crowding stress induces significant alterations in gut microbiota composition and metabolic pathways in fish
statement: 此外，拥挤应激会导致鱼类肠道菌群组成和代谢途径发生显著改变。
text_zh: 此外，拥挤应激会导致鱼类肠道菌群组成和代谢途径发生显著改变。
text_en: In addition, crowding stress causes significant changes in the gut microbiota composition and metabolic pathways of fish.

quote: Prior to experimentation, fish underwent a 7-day acclimation phase under natural conditions.
statement: 实验前，鱼在自然条件下进行了为期7天的驯化阶段。
text_zh: 实验前，鱼在自然条件下进行了为期7天的驯化阶段。
text_en: Before the experiment, the fish underwent a 7-day acclimation period under natural conditions.

quote: The control (CON) group had a low stocking density of 44.4 fish/m 3 , while the high stocking density in the crowding stress groups (CS, CSLTP, CSMTP, and CSHTP) was set at 222.2 fish/m 3 .
statement: 对照组采用低放养密度（44.4尾/立方米），而拥挤应激组采用高放养密度（222.2尾/立方米）。
text_zh: 对照组采用低放养密度（44.4尾/立方米），而拥挤应激组采用高放养密度（222.2尾/立方米）。
text_en: The control group used a low stocking density (44.4 fish/m³), while the crowding stress group used a high stocking density (222.2 fish/m³).

quote: Throughout the trial, the ponds were regularly disinfected and water quality conditioned, and the physicochemical factors of the pond water environment, dissolved oxygen (>5.00 mg/L), water temperature (30.0 ± 2 °C) and pH (7.16–7.38), and unionized ammonia nitrogen
statement: 在整个试验期间，池塘定期消毒并调节水质，溶解氧、水温和pH值等理化因子被监测和控制。
text_zh: 在整个试验期间，池塘定期消毒并调节水质，溶解氧、水温和pH值等理化因子被监测和控制。
text_en: Throughout the entire trial period, ponds were regularly disinfected and water quality was adjusted; physicochemical factors such as dissolved oxygen, water temperature, and pH were monitored and controlled.

quote: The fish were anesthetized using MS-222 (Merck, Darmstadt, Germany).
statement: 使用MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 使用MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish are anesthetized using MS-222.

quote: Blood was collected from the caudal vein and immediately centrifuged at 3000× g for 10 min at 4 °C.
statement: 从尾静脉采集血液，并在4°C下以3000×g离心10分钟。
text_zh: 从尾静脉采集血液，并在4°C下以3000×g离心10分钟。
text_en: Blood was collected from the tail vein and centrifuged at 3000×g for 10 minutes at 4°C.

quote: The fish after blood sampling were immediately placed on ice.
statement: 采血后的鱼立即置于冰上。
text_zh: 采血后的鱼立即置于冰上。
text_en: Fish were immediately placed on ice after blood sampling.

quote: Therefore, this study was designed to systematically investigate whether dietary TPs supplementation can effectively alleviate chronic crowding stress in HCC2 and elucidate the underlying mechanisms.
statement: 本研究旨在系统调查日粮中添加茶多酚（TPs）是否能有效缓解HCC2鲫鱼的慢性拥挤应激。
text_zh: 本研究旨在系统调查日粮中添加茶多酚（TPs）是否能有效缓解HCC2鲫鱼的慢性拥挤应激。
text_en: This study aims to systematically investigate whether dietary supplementation with tea polyphenols (TPs) can effectively alleviate chronic crowding stress in HCC2 crucian carp.

quote: We hypothesize that TPs exert protective effects through enhancing antioxidant capacity, regulating lipid metabolism, and modulating the gut microbiome.
statement: 作者假设茶多酚通过增强抗氧化能力、调节脂质代谢和调节肠道微生物群发挥保护作用。
text_zh: 作者假设茶多酚通过增强抗氧化能力、调节脂质代谢和调节肠道微生物群发挥保护作用。
text_en: The authors hypothesize that tea polyphenols exert protective effects by enhancing antioxidant capacity, regulating lipid metabolism, and modulating gut microbiota.
outcome: 抗氧化能力、脂质代谢、肠道微生物群

quote: By integrating microbiome analysis, we specifically aimed to evaluate how crowding stress and TPs intervention reshape intestinal microbial diversity and composition, assessing its potential influence on host health and stress resilience.
statement: 通过整合微生物组分析，研究旨在评估拥挤应激和茶多酚干预如何重塑肠道微生物多样性和组成，并评估其对宿主健康和应激恢复力的潜在影响。
text_zh: 通过整合微生物组分析，研究旨在评估拥挤应激和茶多酚干预如何重塑肠道微生物多样性和组成，并评估其对宿主健康和应激恢复力的潜在影响。
text_en: By integrating microbiome analysis, the study aims to evaluate how crowding stress and tea polyphenol intervention reshape intestinal microbial diversity and composition, and to assess their potential impact on host health and stress resilience.
outcome: 肠道微生物多样性、组成、宿主健康、应激恢复力

quote: This research provides insights into TPs’ action against crowding stress and offers robust scientific support for the application of this natural, plant-based additive as a sustainable strategy to improve fish welfare and productivity in high-density aquaculture systems.
statement: 该研究提供了关于茶多酚对抗拥挤应激作用的见解，并为将这种天然植物基添加剂作为改善高密度水产养殖系统中鱼类福利和生产力的可持续策略提供科学支持。
text_zh: 该研究提供了关于茶多酚对抗拥挤应激作用的见解，并为将这种天然植物基添加剂作为改善高密度水产养殖系统中鱼类福利和生产力的可持续策略提供科学支持。
text_en: This study provides insights into the effects of tea polyphenols against crowding stress and offers scientific support for using this natural plant-based additive as a sustainable strategy to improve fish welfare and productivity in high-density aquaculture systems.

quote: Compared with the CON group, the crowding stress conditions (CS group) significantly decreased FBW, WGR, SGR, and FE
statement: 与对照组相比，拥挤胁迫条件显著降低了杂交鲫HCC2的最终体重、增重率、特定生长率和饲料效率。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，拥挤胁迫条件显著降低了杂交鲫HCC2的最终体重、增重率、特定生长率和饲料效率。
text_en: Compared with the control group, crowding stress significantly reduced the final body weight, weight gain rate, specific growth rate, and feed efficiency of hybrid crucian carp HCC2.

quote: Compared with the CS group, the CSMTP group exhibited a significantly lower CF
statement: 与拥挤胁迫组相比，补充TPs的拥挤胁迫组表现出显著更低的肥满度。
text_zh: 与拥挤胁迫组相比，补充TPs的拥挤胁迫组表现出显著更低的肥满度。
text_en: Compared to the crowding stress group, the crowding stress group supplemented with TPs showed significantly lower condition factor.

quote: Compared with the CON group, the CS group significantly increased serum LDH and TG
statement: 与对照组相比，拥挤胁迫组血清乳酸脱氢酶和甘油三酯显著升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，拥挤胁迫组血清乳酸脱氢酶和甘油三酯显著升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, serum lactate dehydrogenase and triglycerides were significantly increased in the crowding stress group.

quote: Dietary TP groups significantly decreased LDH and GLU
statement: 日粮添加TPs的组别显著降低了乳酸脱氢酶和葡萄糖水平。
text_zh: 日粮添加TPs的组别显著降低了乳酸脱氢酶和葡萄糖水平。
text_en: The group supplemented with TPs in the diet significantly reduced lactate dehydrogenase and glucose levels.

quote: the adoption of plant-based feed additives may be a feasible nutritional strategy
statement: 采用植物源饲料添加剂可能是一种可行的营养策略，以平衡动物福利与经济效益。
text_zh: 采用植物源饲料添加剂可能是一种可行的营养策略，以平衡动物福利与经济效益。
text_en: The use of plant-based feed additives may be a feasible nutritional strategy to balance animal welfare and economic benefits.
outcome: 动物福利与经济效益平衡

quote: Recently, TPs have garnered considerable attention owing to their anti-stress properties
statement: 最近，茶多酚因其抗应激特性而受到广泛关注。
text_zh: 最近，茶多酚因其抗应激特性而受到广泛关注。
text_en: Recently, tea polyphenols have received widespread attention due to their anti-stress properties.

quote: Alteration of intestinal redox status is an intrinsic key factor in regulating the state of intestinal tissue, and the overproduction of ROS is one of the main culprits leading to inflammation [ 51 ].
statement: 肠道氧化还原状态的改变是调节肠道组织状态的关键内在因素，活性氧（ROS）的过量产生是导致炎症的主要原因之一。
text_zh: 肠道氧化还原状态的改变是调节肠道组织状态的关键内在因素，活性氧（ROS）的过量产生是导致炎症的主要原因之一。
text_en: Changes in the intestinal redox state are a key intrinsic factor regulating the condition of intestinal tissue, and excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) is one of the main causes of inflammation.

quote: Altered antioxidant enzyme activities, such as glutathione (GSH), SOD, CAT, and MDA are often used as evaluation criteria to detect the antioxidant function of organisms [ 52 ].
statement: 谷胱甘肽（GSH）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和丙二醛（MDA）等抗氧化酶活性的变化常被用作检测生物体抗氧化功能的评估标准。
text_zh: 谷胱甘肽（GSH）、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、过氧化氢酶（CAT）和丙二醛（MDA）等抗氧化酶活性的变化常被用作检测生物体抗氧化功能的评估标准。
text_en: Changes in the activities of antioxidant enzymes such as glutathione (GSH), superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and malondialdehyde (MDA) are often used as evaluation criteria for detecting the antioxidant function of organisms.

quote: When compared to the G0 group, the G3 and other groups had considerably higher T-AOC and SOD enzymatic activity (Figure S1A–C).
statement: 与G0组相比，G3组和其他组的总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）和SOD酶活性显著较高。
text_zh: 与G0组相比，G3组和其他组的总抗氧化能力（T-AOC）和SOD酶活性显著较高。
text_en: Compared with the G0 group, the total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC) and SOD enzyme activity were significantly higher in the G3 group and other groups.

quote: Simultaneously, the relative activity of MDA, a key lipid peroxidation product, was suppressed and dramatically reduced in the G3 group.
statement: 同时，作为关键脂质过氧化产物的MDA相对活性在G3组中受到抑制并显著降低。
text_zh: 同时，作为关键脂质过氧化产物的MDA相对活性在G3组中受到抑制并显著降低。
text_en: Meanwhile, the relative activity of MDA, a key lipid peroxidation product, was inhibited and significantly decreased in the G3 group.

quote: It is worth noting that an appropriate supplementation amount is key to ensuring optimal AMP function, as excessive addition will reduce the activity of antioxidant enzymes and lead to the development of inflammation.
statement: 值得注意的是，适当的补充量是确保AMP最佳功能的关键，因为过量添加会降低抗氧化酶的活性并导致炎症的发展。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，适当的补充量是确保AMP最佳功能的关键，因为过量添加会降低抗氧化酶的活性并导致炎症的发展。
text_en: It is worth noting that appropriate supplementation levels are key to ensuring the optimal function of AMPs, as excessive addition reduces antioxidant enzyme activity and leads to the development of inflammation.
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性与炎症风险
counterevidence: 过量添加会导致负面效果

quote: By measuring the activity of α-chmo, α-Ams, and Lip, we found that the intestinal digestive enzymes were significantly activated, and that the G3 group had the most obvious effect (Figure S1D,E).
statement: 通过测量α-糜蛋白酶、α-淀粉酶和脂肪酶的活性，发现肠道消化酶被显著激活，且G3组的效果最为明显。
text_zh: 通过测量α-糜蛋白酶、α-淀粉酶和脂肪酶的活性，发现肠道消化酶被显著激活，且G3组的效果最为明显。
text_en: By measuring the activities of alpha-chymotrypsin, alpha-amylase, and lipase, it was found that intestinal digestive enzymes were significantly activated, with the effect being most pronounced in the G3 group.

quote: This indicates that AMPs improve intestinal digestive function not only by promoting the development of intestinal villi but also by increasing the activity of intestinal digestive enzymes.
statement: 这表明抗菌肽（AMPs）不仅通过促进肠绒毛发育，还通过增加肠道消化酶活性来改善肠道消化功能。
text_zh: 这表明抗菌肽（AMPs）不仅通过促进肠绒毛发育，还通过增加肠道消化酶活性来改善肠道消化功能。
text_en: This indicates that antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) improve intestinal digestive function not only by promoting intestinal villus development, but also by increasing intestinal digestive enzyme activity.

quote: This result confirms the conclusion that AMPs improve intestinal digestive enzymes in studies of broiler chickens and juvenile goats [ 54 ].
statement: 这一结果证实了肉鸡和幼年山羊研究中关于AMPs改善肠道消化酶的结论。
text_zh: 这一结果证实了肉鸡和幼年山羊研究中关于AMPs改善肠道消化酶的结论。
text_en: This result confirms the conclusion from studies on broilers and young goats that AMPs improve intestinal digestive enzymes.

quote: Intestinal oxidative stress is thought to be a side effect of the inflammatory process, with redox imbalance being a symptom of inflammatory assaults.
statement: 肠道氧化应激被认为是炎症过程的副作用，氧化还原失衡是炎症攻击的症状。
text_zh: 肠道氧化应激被认为是炎症过程的副作用，氧化还原失衡是炎症攻击的症状。
text_en: Intestinal oxidative stress is considered a side effect of the inflammatory process, and redox imbalance is a symptom of inflammatory attack.
outcome: 氧化应激与炎症的关系

quote: At the same time, AMPs can improve the composition of intestinal microbiota, increase the abundance of Firmicutes and Bacteroidetes to promote intestinal energy absorption, and increase the abundance of Actinomycetes to maintain intestinal homeostasis.
statement: AMPs improve intestinal microbiota composition by increasing Firmicutes and Bacteroidetes to promote energy absorption, and increasing Actinomycetes to maintain homeostasis.
text_en: AMPs improve intestinal microbiota composition by increasing Firmicutes and Bacteroidetes to promote energy absorption, and increasing Actinomycetes to maintain homeostasis.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成与能量吸收

quote: Moreover, AMPs can endow the intestinal microbiota with a more favorable species composition after infection with pathogenic bacteria.
statement: AMPs result in a more favorable intestinal microbiota species composition following bacterial infection.
text_en: AMPs result in a more favorable intestinal microbiota species composition following bacterial infection.

quote: The significantly increased Cetobacterium and the significantly decreased Proteobacteria both contributed to an organism’s ability to acquire higher disease resistance through SCFAs and anti-inflammatory factors.
statement: Increased Cetobacterium and decreased Proteobacteria contribute to higher disease resistance through SCFAs and anti-inflammatory factors.
text_en: Increased Cetobacterium and decreased Proteobacteria contribute to higher disease resistance through SCFAs and anti-inflammatory factors.

quote: It should be reiterated that the supplementation level of AMPs is very important because high levels reduce their effect and can even have adverse effects.
statement: High supplementation levels of AMPs reduce their efficacy and may cause adverse effects.
text_en: High supplementation levels of AMPs reduce their efficacy and may cause adverse effects.

quote: In conclusion, adding an appropriate amount of AMPs (400 mg/kg in this experiment) could directly and indirectly improve the intestinal function of Carassius auratus var. Pengze and regulate the composition of intestinal microbes.
statement: Adding 400 mg/kg of AMPs improved intestinal function and regulated microbial composition in Carassius auratus var. Pengze.
text_en: Adding 400 mg/kg of AMPs improved intestinal function and regulated microbial composition in Carassius auratus var. Pengze.

quote: The unclassified genus norank_f_Rhizobiales_Incertae_Sedis was the most abundant taxon in all groups, representing 25% in the CON group, increasing to 35% under crowding stress (CS group), and declining to 20% in the CSHTP group.
statement: 未分类属norank_f_Rhizobiales_Incertae_Sedis在所有组中均为最丰富的分类单元，在对照组中占25%，在拥挤胁迫下增加至35%，并在CSHTP组中下降至20%。
text_zh: 未分类属norank_f_Rhizobiales_Incertae_Sedis在所有组中均为最丰富的分类单元，在对照组中占25%，在拥挤胁迫下增加至35%，并在CSHTP组中下降至20%。
text_en: The unclassified genus norank_f_Rhizobiales_Incertae_Sedis was the most abundant taxon in all groups, accounting for 25% in the control group, increasing to 35% under crowding stress, and decreasing to 20% in the CSHTP group.

quote: Interestingly, the genus Lactococcus dominated in the CON group, but the stress-sensitive genera like unclassified_c_Bacilli and Pantoea nearly disappeared in the CS group but reappeared at 2–5% in treatment groups.
statement: 乳球菌属在对照组中占主导地位，但像unclassified_c_Bacilli和泛菌属等对压力敏感的属在拥挤胁迫组中几乎消失，而在处理组中以2-5%的比例重新出现。
text_zh: 乳球菌属在对照组中占主导地位，但像unclassified_c_Bacilli和泛菌属等对压力敏感的属在拥挤胁迫组中几乎消失，而在处理组中以2-5%的比例重新出现。
text_en: Lactococcus was dominant in the control group, but stress-sensitive genera such as unclassified_c_Bacilli and Pantoea nearly disappeared in the crowding stress group, while reappearing at a proportion of 2-5% in the treatment group.

quote: Stressors typically challenge various physiological functions as fish strive to restore their homeostatic status.
statement: 应激源通常挑战鱼类的各种生理功能，因为鱼类努力恢复其稳态状态。
text_zh: 应激源通常挑战鱼类的各种生理功能，因为鱼类努力恢复其稳态状态。
text_en: Stressors typically challenge various physiological functions of fish, as fish strive to restore their homeostatic state.

quote: Moreover, enhancing the host’s innate immune mechanisms, health condition, and growth rate represents an ideal approach for disease and stress management in modern aquaculture [ 24 ].
statement: 此外，增强宿主的先天免疫机制、健康状况和生长率是现代水产养殖中疾病和应激管理的理想方法。
text_zh: 此外，增强宿主的先天免疫机制、健康状况和生长率是现代水产养殖中疾病和应激管理的理想方法。
text_en: In addition, enhancing the host's innate immune mechanisms, health status, and growth rate is an ideal method for disease and stress management in modern aquaculture.

quote: This method optimized pellet integrity and water stability, critical for crucian carp feeding behavior.
statement: 该方法优化了颗粒完整性和水中稳定性，这对鲫鱼的摄食行为至关重要。
text_zh: 该方法优化了颗粒完整性和水中稳定性，这对鲫鱼的摄食行为至关重要。
text_en: This method optimized pellet integrity and water stability, which is crucial for feeding behavior in crucian carp.

quote: Each replicate was housed in a cage (1.5 × 1.5 × 1.0 m 3) for a 60-d
statement: 每个重复饲养在一个网箱（1.5 × 1.5 × 1.0立方米）中，持续60天。
text_zh: 每个重复饲养在一个网箱（1.5 × 1.5 × 1.0立方米）中，持续60天。
text_en: Each replicate was reared in a cage (1.5 × 1.5 × 1.0 cubic meters) for 60 days.

quote: neither the stress conditions nor the TPs treatment had a significant impact on the survival rate
statement: Neither the stress conditions nor the tannic polyphenols (TPs) treatment had a significant impact on the survival rate.
text_en: Neither the stress conditions nor the tannic polyphenols (TPs) treatment had a significant impact on the survival rate.

quote: This finding implies that the existing stress levels did not result in a marked increase in fish mortality, and the administered dose of TPs did not adversely affect fish survival.
statement: The existing stress levels did not result in a marked increase in fish mortality, and the administered dose of TPs did not adversely affect fish survival.
text_en: The existing stress levels did not result in a marked increase in fish mortality, and the administered dose of TPs did not adversely affect fish survival.

quote: Crowding stress significantly shifts energy metabolism toward anaerobic pathways, as indicated by increased serum LDH and TG levels in high stocking density groups, reflecting enhanced glycolytic activity and abnormal lipid accumulation
statement: Crowding stress significantly shifts energy metabolism toward anaerobic pathways, indicated by increased serum LDH and TG levels in high stocking density groups.
text_en: Crowding stress significantly shifts energy metabolism toward anaerobic pathways, indicated by increased serum LDH and TG levels in high stocking density groups.

quote: Conversely, TPs intervention demonstrates dose-dependent improvements, reduced LDH levels alongside upregulated hepatic CPT1 expression activate the PPARα signaling pathway, enhancing fatty acid β-oxidation.
statement: TPs intervention demonstrates dose-dependent improvements, reducing LDH levels and activating the PPARα signaling pathway via upregulated hepatic CPT1 expression to enhance fatty acid β-oxidation.
text_en: TPs intervention demonstrates dose-dependent improvements, reducing LDH levels and activating the PPARα signaling pathway via upregulated hepatic CPT1 expression to enhance fatty acid β-oxidation.

quote: Ps restructured the intestinal microbiota composition of loaches (Paramisgurnus dabryanus) under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress, with specific enrichment of metabolic pathways associated with amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis, revealing a potential microbial-mediated mechanism for environmental stress adaptation [ 21 ].
statement: 在慢性氨氮胁迫下，Ps重组了泥鳅的肠道微生物群组成，并特异性富集了与氨基酸和核苷酸生物合成相关的代谢途径。
text_zh: 在慢性氨氮胁迫下，Ps重组了泥鳅的肠道微生物群组成，并特异性富集了与氨基酸和核苷酸生物合成相关的代谢途径。
text_en: Under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress, Ps restructured the gut microbiota composition of loach and specifically enriched metabolic pathways related to amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis.

quote: Based on the results above, we hypothesize that crowding stress may lead to alterations in the structure of the intestinal microbiota in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.
statement: 作者假设拥挤胁迫可能导致杂交鲫鱼HCC2肠道微生物群结构的改变。
text_zh: 作者假设拥挤胁迫可能导致杂交鲫鱼HCC2肠道微生物群结构的改变。
text_en: The authors hypothesized that crowding stress may lead to changes in the gut microbiota structure of hybrid crucian carp HCC2.

quote: it is essential to find appropriate nutritional strategies to promote fish growth and improve their welfare
statement: 寻找适当的营养策略以促进鱼类生长和改善其福利至关重要。
text_zh: 寻找适当的营养策略以促进鱼类生长和改善其福利至关重要。
text_en: Finding appropriate nutritional strategies to promote fish growth and improve their welfare is crucial.

quote: Our study systematically revealed for the first time that TPs alleviate chronic crowding stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2 via multifaceted mechanisms, including antioxidant enhancement, lipid metabolism regulation, and intestinal microbiota modulation.
statement: 本研究首次系统揭示单宁（TPs）通过抗氧化增强、脂质代谢调节和肠道菌群调节等多重机制缓解杂交鲫鱼HCC2的慢性拥挤应激。
text_zh: 本研究首次系统揭示单宁（TPs）通过抗氧化增强、脂质代谢调节和肠道菌群调节等多重机制缓解杂交鲫鱼HCC2的慢性拥挤应激。
text_en: This study is the first to systematically reveal that tannins (TPs) alleviate chronic crowding stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2 through multiple mechanisms including enhanced antioxidant capacity, regulation of lipid metabolism, and modulation of gut microbiota.

quote: Under crowding stress, the growth and development of individuals experience a delay, concomitantly with a diminution in immune function.
statement: 在拥挤应激下，个体的生长发育出现延迟，同时免疫功能下降。
text_zh: 在拥挤应激下，个体的生长发育出现延迟，同时免疫功能下降。
text_en: Under crowding stress, individual growth and development are delayed, while immune function declines.

quote: such organisms are compelled to allocate increased energy to satisfy the escalated metabolic demands, consequently leading to an inhibition of somatic growth
statement: 此类生物被迫分配更多能量以满足增加的代谢需求，从而导致体细胞生长受到抑制。
text_zh: 此类生物被迫分配更多能量以满足增加的代谢需求，从而导致体细胞生长受到抑制。
text_en: These organisms are forced to allocate more energy to meet increased metabolic demands, resulting in suppressed somatic growth.
intervention_record: 高代谢需求/能量重分配

quote: high-density rearing significantly suppressed the final body weight (FBW decreased by 37.4%), weight gain rate (WGR decreased by 42.4%), and specific growth rate (SGR decreased by 43.4%) of HCC2
statement: 高密度养殖显著抑制了HCC2的最终体重（降低37.4%）、增重率（降低42.4%）和特定生长率（降低43.4%）。
text_zh: 高密度养殖显著抑制了HCC2的最终体重（降低37.4%）、增重率（降低42.4%）和特定生长率（降低43.4%）。
text_en: High-density farming significantly inhibited the final body weight of HCC2 (a decrease of 37.4%), weight gain rate (a decrease of 42.4%), and specific growth rate (a decrease of 43.4%).

quote: However, the persistence of 1061 core OTUs shared across all experimental groups implies that essential microbiota responsible for maintaining fundamental intestinal functions remained resilient under both stress and treatment conditions, consistent with observations in crucian carp (Carassius auratus) under environmental perturbations [ 40 ].
statement: 所有实验组共享的1061个核心OTU的存在意味着负责维持基本肠道功能的关键微生物群在应激和处理条件下保持韧性。
text_zh: 所有实验组共享的1061个核心OTU的存在意味着负责维持基本肠道功能的关键微生物群在应激和处理条件下保持韧性。
text_en: The presence of the 1061 core OTUs shared by all experimental groups implies that key microbiota responsible for maintaining basic gut functions remain resilient under stress and treatment conditions.

quote: In summary, these findings suggested that crowding stress altered gut microbial richness and composition in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.
statement: 这些发现表明拥挤应激改变了杂交鲫HCC2的肠道微生物丰富度和组成。
text_zh: 这些发现表明拥挤应激改变了杂交鲫HCC2的肠道微生物丰富度和组成。
text_en: These findings indicate that crowding stress altered the intestinal microbial richness and composition of hybrid crucian carp HCC2.
outcome: 肠道微生物丰富度和组成

quote: A similar observation has been reported by Yang et al., demonstrating a significant increase in the abundance of gut microbiota in both the foregut and hindgut of largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) after exposure to acute crowding stress [ 42 ].
statement: Yang等人报告了类似的观察结果，显示大口黑鱼在暴露于急性拥挤应激后，前肠和后肠的肠道微生物丰度显著增加。
text_zh: Yang等人报告了类似的观察结果，显示大口黑鱼在暴露于急性拥挤应激后，前肠和后肠的肠道微生物丰度显著增加。
text_en: Yang et al. reported similar observations, showing that the intestinal microbial abundance in the foregut and hindgut of largemouth bass significantly increased after exposure to acute crowding stress.

quote: A further study by Chai et al. demonstrated that TPs restructured the intestinal microbiota composition of loaches (Paramisgurnus dabryanus) under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress, with specific enrichment of metabolic pathways associated with amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis, revealing a potential microbial-mediated mechanism for environmenta
statement: Chai等人的进一步研究表明，在慢性氨氮应激下，茶多酚重构了泥鳅的肠道微生物群组成，并特异性富集了与氨基酸和核苷酸生物合成相关的代谢途径。
text_zh: Chai等人的进一步研究表明，在慢性氨氮应激下，茶多酚重构了泥鳅的肠道微生物群组成，并特异性富集了与氨基酸和核苷酸生物合成相关的代谢途径。
text_en: Further research by Chai et al. showed that under chronic ammonia nitrogen stress, tea polyphenols restructured the gut microbiota composition of loach and specifically enriched metabolic pathways related to amino acid and nucleotide biosynthesis.
outcome: 肠道微生物群组成及代谢途径

quote: The Sobs index, which directly measures species richness by indicating the observed number of OTUs, demonstrates that crowding stress or TP treatments significantly reduce species count in intestinal microbiota (Figure 2 A).
statement: Sobs指数表明，拥挤应激或TP处理显著降低了肠道微生物群中的物种数量。
text_zh: Sobs指数表明，拥挤应激或TP处理显著降低了肠道微生物群中的物种数量。
text_en: The Sobs index indicates that crowding stress or TP treatment significantly reduced the number of species in the gut microbiota.

quote: While the Shannon index evaluates both species richness and evenness (Figure 2 B), its analysis reveals that, although the Sobs index exhibited substantial fluctuations, microbial community evenness (i.e., the equilibrium of species relative abundances) remained largely unaffected, maintaining overall α-diversity stability.
statement: Shannon指数分析显示，尽管Sobs指数波动较大，但微生物群落均匀度基本未受影响，维持了整体α多样性的稳定性。
text_zh: Shannon指数分析显示，尽管Sobs指数波动较大，但微生物群落均匀度基本未受影响，维持了整体α多样性的稳定性。
text_en: Shannon index analysis showed that although the Sobs index fluctuated significantly, microbial community evenness was basically unaffected, maintaining the stability of overall alpha diversity.
outcome: 肠道微生物群落均匀度

quote: Complementary to these findings, the Chao index (Figure 2 C) estimates total species richness—including undetected rare species—and aligns with Sobs index trends, further supporting the observed reduction in microbial diversity under specific treatments.
statement: Chao指数与Sobs指数的趋势一致，进一步支持了在特定处理下观察到的微生物多样性降低。
text_zh: Chao指数与Sobs指数的趋势一致，进一步支持了在特定处理下观察到的微生物多样性降低。
text_en: The trends of the Chao index and the Sobs index are consistent, further supporting the observed reduction in microbial diversity under specific treatments.

quote: Furthermore, the Venn diagrams (Figure 3) indicate that crowding stress altered the distribution of OTUs in the intestinal microbiota of hybrid crucian carp, suggesting stress-induced microbial dysbiosis and reduced diversity of the original microbiota [ 39 ].
statement: Venn图显示拥挤应激改变了杂交鲫鱼肠道微生物群中OTU的分布，暗示应激诱导的微生物失调和原始微生物群多样性的降低。
text_zh: Venn图显示拥挤应激改变了杂交鲫鱼肠道微生物群中OTU的分布，暗示应激诱导的微生物失调和原始微生物群多样性的降低。
text_en: The Venn diagram shows that crowding stress altered the distribution of OTUs in the gut microbiota of hybrid crucian carp, suggesting stress-induced microbial dysbiosis and a reduction in original microbiota diversity.

quote: This study demonstrates that dietary supplementation with TPs effectively alleviates chronic crowding stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.
statement: 本研究表明，日粮中添加茶多酚（TPs）能有效缓解杂交鲫鱼HCC2的慢性拥挤应激。
text_zh: 本研究表明，日粮中添加茶多酚（TPs）能有效缓解杂交鲫鱼HCC2的慢性拥挤应激。
text_en: This study shows that dietary supplementation with tea polyphenols (TPs) can effectively alleviate chronic crowding stress in hybrid crucian carp HCC2.

quote: Mechanistically, TPs enhance antioxidant defense by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway, increasing the activities of antioxidant enzymes, elevating glutathione levels, and mitigating oxidative stress.
statement: 在机制上，茶多酚通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路、增加抗氧化酶活性、提高谷胱甘肽水平来增强抗氧化防御，从而减轻氧化应激。
text_zh: 在机制上，茶多酚通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路、增加抗氧化酶活性、提高谷胱甘肽水平来增强抗氧化防御，从而减轻氧化应激。
text_en: Mechanistically, tea polyphenols enhance antioxidant defense by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway, increasing antioxidant enzyme activity, and raising glutathione levels, thereby alleviating oxidative stress.
outcome: 氧化应激与抗氧化防御

quote: Furthermore, TPs ameliorate stress-induced gut microbiota dysbiosis by reducing Proteobacteria proliferation while restoring Firmicutes abundance, consequently diminishing stress-associated pathogenic risks.
statement: 此外，茶多酚通过减少变形菌门增殖并恢复厚壁菌门丰度，改善应激诱导的肠道菌群失调，从而降低与应激相关的致病风险。
text_zh: 此外，茶多酚通过减少变形菌门增殖并恢复厚壁菌门丰度，改善应激诱导的肠道菌群失调，从而降低与应激相关的致病风险。
text_en: In addition, tea polyphenols improve stress-induced intestinal microbiota dysbiosis by reducing the proliferation of Proteobacteria and restoring the abundance of Firmicutes, thereby lowering the risk of stress-related pathogens.

quote: A previous investigation showed that the gut microbiome of Megalobrama amblycephala plays a dominant role in the adaptation to crowding stress, and the abundance of microbes was significantly changed [ 46 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，团头鲂的肠道微生物组在适应拥挤应激中起主导作用，且微生物丰度发生了显著变化。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，团头鲂的肠道微生物组在适应拥挤应激中起主导作用，且微生物丰度发生了显著变化。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that the gut microbiome of blunt snout bream plays a leading role in adapting to crowding stress, and microbial abundance has changed significantly.
outcome: 肠道微生物组适应性与丰度

quote: Therefore, the specific microbial alterations serve as a critical factor in the mechanism by which TPs mitigate crowding stress.
statement: 因此，特定的微生物改变是茶多酚（TPs）缓解拥挤应激机制中的关键因素。
text_zh: 因此，特定的微生物改变是茶多酚（TPs）缓解拥挤应激机制中的关键因素。
text_en: Therefore, specific microbial changes are a key factor in the mechanism by which tea polyphenols (TPs) alleviate crowding stress.

quote: Proteobacteria is known to encompass pathogens, such as Vibrio alginolyticus , Aeromonas hydrophila , and Pseudomonas . The high abundance of Proteobacteria observed in the CS group may suggest potential gut dysbiosis or immune system activation in fish [ 48 ].
statement: 变形菌门包含弧菌、嗜水气单胞菌和假单胞菌等病原体；拥挤应激组中观察到的变形菌门高丰度可能暗示鱼类存在潜在的肠道菌群失调或免疫系统激活。
text_zh: 变形菌门包含弧菌、嗜水气单胞菌和假单胞菌等病原体；拥挤应激组中观察到的变形菌门高丰度可能暗示鱼类存在潜在的肠道菌群失调或免疫系统激活。
text_en: The phylum Proteobacteria includes pathogens such as Vibrio, Aeromonas hydrophila, and Pseudomonas; the high abundance of Proteobacteria observed in the crowding stress group may suggest potential gut microbiota dysbiosis or immune system activation in fish.
outcome: 肠道菌群失调与免疫激活

quote: However, numerous studies have shown that TPs exhibit significant inhibitory effects on pathogenic bacteria of the Proteobacteria in aquatic animals.
statement: 然而，大量研究表明，茶多酚（TPs）对水生动物中变形菌门的致病菌表现出显著的抑制作用。
text_zh: 然而，大量研究表明，茶多酚（TPs）对水生动物中变形菌门的致病菌表现出显著的抑制作用。
text_en: However, numerous studies have shown that tea polyphenols (TPs) exhibit significant inhibitory effects on pathogenic bacteria of the phylum Proteobacteria in aquatic animals.

quote: For instance, the supplementation of 120 mg/kg TPs could effectively alleviate the intestinal barrier function injury induced by Aeromonas hydrophila in grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) [ 49 ].
statement: 例如，补充120 mg/kg的茶多酚能有效缓解草鱼中由嗜水气单胞菌诱导的肠屏障功能损伤。
text_zh: 例如，补充120 mg/kg的茶多酚能有效缓解草鱼中由嗜水气单胞菌诱导的肠屏障功能损伤。
text_en: For example, supplementation with 120 mg/kg tea polyphenols can effectively alleviate intestinal barrier dysfunction induced by Aeromonas hydrophila in grass carp.

quote: Further, Firmicutes linked to energy harvest and short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) production, and their dominance could reflect enhanced energy metabolism to cope with crowding stress [ 50 ].
statement: 此外，厚壁菌门与能量获取和短链脂肪酸产生有关，其优势地位可能反映了为应对拥挤应激而增强的能量代谢。
text_zh: 此外，厚壁菌门与能量获取和短链脂肪酸产生有关，其优势地位可能反映了为应对拥挤应激而增强的能量代谢。
text_en: In addition, Firmicutes are associated with energy acquisition and short-chain fatty acid production, and their dominance may reflect enhanced energy metabolism in response to crowding stress.

quote: Analysis of the antioxidant system revealed that, in the CS group, the SOD activity in the liver increased by 17.5%, while the GSH content decreased by 39.2% (Table 5).
statement: 在拥挤应激（CS）组中，肝脏SOD活性增加了17.5%，而GSH含量减少了39.2%。
text_zh: 在拥挤应激（CS）组中，肝脏SOD活性增加了17.5%，而GSH含量减少了39.2%。
text_en: In the crowding stress (CS) group, liver SOD activity increased by 17.5%, while GSH content decreased by 39.2%.

quote: This compensatory antioxidant response is consistent with the oxidative stress characteristics found in the long-term crowding stress of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella) [ 6 ].
statement: 这种补偿性抗氧化反应与草鱼长期拥挤应激中发现的氧化应激特征一致。
text_zh: 这种补偿性抗氧化反应与草鱼长期拥挤应激中发现的氧化应激特征一致。
text_en: This compensatory antioxidant response is consistent with the oxidative stress characteristics found in grass carp under long-term crowding stress.

quote: After TPs supplementation, the serum CAT activity increased by 48.9%, and the expression of the nrf2 gene in the liver was upregulated by 2.3 times (Figure 1), confirming that it enhances the expression of phase II detoxification enzymes by activating the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway.
statement: 补充茶多酚（TPs）后，血清CAT活性增加48.9%，肝脏nrf2基因表达上调2.3倍，证实通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路增强II相解毒酶的表达。
text_zh: 补充茶多酚（TPs）后，血清CAT活性增加48.9%，肝脏nrf2基因表达上调2.3倍，证实通过激活Nrf2/Keap1通路增强II相解毒酶的表达。
text_en: Supplementation with tea polyphenols (TPs) increased serum CAT activity by 48.9% and upregulated liver nrf2 gene expression by 2.3-fold, confirming the enhancement of phase II detoxifying enzyme expression through activation of the Nrf2/Keap1 pathway.

quote: Similarly, Mi et al. found that adding dietary (-)-Epicatechin (one kind of TPs) regulates antioxidant status by the same mechanism in Yellow River carp (Cyprinus carpio) [ 36 ].
statement: Mi等人发现，在黄河鲤鱼日粮中添加(-)-表儿茶素（一种茶多酚）通过相同机制调节抗氧化状态。
text_zh: Mi等人发现，在黄河鲤鱼日粮中添加(-)-表儿茶素（一种茶多酚）通过相同机制调节抗氧化状态。
text_en: Mi et al. found that dietary supplementation with (-)-epicatechin (a tea polyphenol) in the diet of Yellow River carp regulated antioxidant status through the same mechanism.

quote: Additionally, TPs increase ALP activity, potentially improving enterohepatic lipoprotein assembly and liver function, while stabilizing stress-induced elevations in AST and ALT levels, thus reducing hepatocyte membrane permeability and cellular damage.
statement: 此外，TPs增加ALP活性，可能改善肠肝脂蛋白组装和肝功能，同时稳定应激诱导的AST和ALT水平升高，从而减少肝细胞膜通透性和细胞损伤。
text_zh: 此外，TPs增加ALP活性，可能改善肠肝脂蛋白组装和肝功能，同时稳定应激诱导的AST和ALT水平升高，从而减少肝细胞膜通透性和细胞损伤。
text_en: In addition, TPs increased ALP activity, which may improve intestinal and hepatic lipoprotein assembly and liver function, while stabilizing the stress-induced elevation of AST and ALT levels, thereby reducing hepatocyte membrane permeability and cellular damage.
outcome: 肝脏功能与细胞完整性

quote: The synergistic effects of TPs—reducing anaerobic burden via LDH/GLU modulation, promoting lipid oxidation via CPT1-PPARα activation, and enhancing hepatic detoxification via ALP-mediated pathways—collectively restore metabolic homeostasis.
statement: TPs的协同效应——通过LDH/GLU调节减少厌氧负担，通过CPT1-PPARα激活促进脂质氧化，以及通过ALP介导的途径增强肝脏解毒——共同恢复代谢稳态。
text_zh: TPs的协同效应——通过LDH/GLU调节减少厌氧负担，通过CPT1-PPARα激活促进脂质氧化，以及通过ALP介导的途径增强肝脏解毒——共同恢复代谢稳态。
text_en: The synergistic effects of TPs—reducing anaerobic burden via LDH/GLU regulation, promoting lipid oxidation via CPT1-PPARα activation, and enhancing liver detoxification via ALP-mediated pathways—jointly restore metabolic homeostasis.

quote: These findings are consistent with our prior study on TPs alleviating acute heat-stress-induced death of HCC2 through modified lipid metabolisms in the liver [ 34 ].
statement: 这些发现与我们之前关于TPs通过改变肝脏脂质代谢来缓解HCC2急性热应激死亡的研究一致。
text_zh: 这些发现与我们之前关于TPs通过改变肝脏脂质代谢来缓解HCC2急性热应激死亡的研究一致。
text_en: These findings are consistent with our previous study on TPs alleviating acute heat stress mortality in HCC2 by altering hepatic lipid metabolism.

quote: Under crowding stress, fish exhibit stress responses and rely on the antioxidant system to scavenge free radicals, thereby maintaining homeostasis [ 35 ].
statement: 在拥挤胁迫下，鱼类表现出应激反应并依赖抗氧化系统清除自由基，从而维持稳态。
text_zh: 在拥挤胁迫下，鱼类表现出应激反应并依赖抗氧化系统清除自由基，从而维持稳态。
text_en: Under crowding stress, fish exhibit a stress response and rely on the antioxidant system to scavenge free radicals, thereby maintaining homeostasis.
